//! @ref LLP 3000.000.000#16-release-reactivation-and-rollback-foresight-rel5 — future-write risks are distinct from snapshot validation.
use snapback4_core::{Schema, successor::{self, Change}, schema::ColumnDefault};
use std::path::Path;

pub(super) fn risks(candidate: &Schema, old: &Schema, release: u64, dir: &Path) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut risks:Vec<_>=successor::classify(candidate,old).into_iter().filter_map(|step| {
        let path=step.path.strip_prefix("tables.")?;
        let (table,column)=path.split_once(".columns.")?;
        let target=old.tables.get(table)?;
        if target.engine_field(column) || old.maintain_for(table).is_some() || target.maintained.contains_key(column) {return None;}
        let before=target.columns.get(column)?;
        let from=candidate.tables.get(table)?;
        let reason=match from.columns.get(column) {
            None if !before.is_optional() && !matches!(target.defaults.get(column),Some(ColumnDefault::Literal(_))) =>
                "new rows will lack the old required field, so rollback can refuse".to_owned(),
            Some(kind) if kind!=before && matches!(step.change,Change::Narrowing|Change::Destructive) =>
                format!("new writes allowed by {kind} may not fit {before}, so rollback can refuse or hide rows"),
            _ => return None,
        };
        Some(format!("rollback foresight: release {release}, {table}.{column}: {reason}; keep an expand/contract bridge with the old required fields and compatible domains; run `snapback4 rollback {} --to {release} --check --bridge <new-dir>` after writes",dir.display()))
    }).collect();
    for (name,target) in old.visible_tables().filter(|(_,t)|t.ephemeral.is_none()) {
        let Some(from)=candidate.tables.get(name) else {continue;};
        if old.maintain_for(name).is_some() {continue;}
        for (index,definition) in &target.indexes {
            if definition.unique && from.indexes.get(index)!=Some(definition) {
                risks.push(format!("rollback foresight: release {release}, unique index {name}.{index}: future writes may introduce duplicate keys and refuse restoration; keep the old uniqueness in a bridge; run `snapback4 rollback {} --to {release} --check --bridge <new-dir>` after writes",dir.display()));
            }
        }
        if target.constraints.iter().any(|c|!from.constraints.contains(c) && !matches!(c,snapback4_core::schema::Constraint::Unique{..})) {
            risks.push(format!("rollback foresight: release {release}, table {name}: changed constraints may let future writes refuse rollback; preserve old bounds/quotas in a bridge; run `snapback4 rollback {} --to {release} --check --bridge <new-dir>` after writes",dir.display()));
        }
    }
    risks
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    fn schema(source:&str)->Schema {
        let b=snapback4_lang::compile(&[("schema.q".into(),source.into())]);
        assert!(b.diagnostics.is_empty(),"{:?}",b.diagnostics);b.schema
    }
    #[test]
    fn warns_before_any_future_rows_exist_but_compatible_additions_are_quiet() {
        let base="table items:\n  required: int 0..10\n  state: enum('old')\n  public\n";
        let old=schema(base);
        for (candidate,subject) in [
            (base.replace("  required: int 0..10\n",""),"items.required"),
            (base.replace("int 0..10","int 0..20"),"items.required"),
            (base.replace("enum('old')","enum('old','new')"),"items.state"),
            (base.replace("int 0..10","int 0..10 ?"),"items.required"),
        ] {
            let warnings=risks(&schema(&candidate),&old,1,Path::new("deployment"));
            assert!(warnings.iter().any(|w|w.contains(subject)&&w.contains("--to 1 --check --bridge")),"{warnings:?}");
        }
        assert!(risks(&schema(&base.replace("  public","  label: text <=20 ?\n  public")),&old,1,Path::new("deployment")).is_empty());
        let unique=schema(&base.replace("  public","  unique state\n  public"));
        assert!(risks(&old,&unique,1,Path::new("deployment")).iter().any(|w|w.contains("duplicate keys")));
    }
}
use snapback4_lang::{compile, Bound, client_contracts::compare, emit};
use snapback4_core::{Context, Engine, Value};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
fn checked(source: &str) -> Bound {
    let b=compile(&[("schema.q".into(),source.into())]);
    assert!(b.diagnostics.is_empty(),"{:?}",b.diagnostics);b
}
#[test]
fn literal_defaults_aliases_and_deprecated_inputs_execute_the_shared_ir() {
    let b=checked("query current(n: int 0..10 default 4, old: text <=8 deprecated):\n  require n != 9 else NINE\n  return n\nalias original = current\n");
    let mut engine=Engine::memory(b.schema,b.programs.into_iter().map(|p|p.program)).unwrap();
    for name in ["current","original"] {
        for args in [BTreeMap::new(),BTreeMap::from([("n".into(),Value::Null)]),BTreeMap::from([("old".into(),Value::String("legacy".into()))])] {
            assert_eq!(engine.query(name,Context::new("user:a",args)).unwrap().data,Value::Int(4));
        }
        assert_eq!(engine.query(name,Context::new("user:a",BTreeMap::from([("n".into(),Value::Int(6))]))).unwrap().data,Value::Int(6));
        assert!(engine.query(name,Context::new("user:a",BTreeMap::from([("n".into(),Value::Int(11))]))).is_err());
        assert!(engine.query(name,Context::new("user:a",BTreeMap::from([("n".into(),Value::Int(9))]))).is_err());
        assert!(engine.query(name,Context::new("user:a",BTreeMap::from([("old".into(),Value::Int(2))]))).is_err());
    }
}
#[test]
fn invalid_modifiers_and_aliases_refuse_without_silent_semantic_changes() {
    for source in [
        "query q(n: int default 11):\n  return n\n".replace("int default", "int 0..10 default"),
        "query q(n: int default now):\n  return n\n".into(),
        "query q(n: int default null):\n  return n\n".into(),
        "query q(n: int default 1 deprecated):\n  return 1\n".into(),
        "query q(n: int deprecated):\n  return n\n".into(),
        "fn f(n: int default 1):\n  return n\nquery q():\n  return f(1)\n".into(),
        "job j(n: int default 1): native\n".into(),
        "query q():\n  return 1\nalias a = q\nalias b = a\n".into(),
        "query q():\n  return 1\nalias q = q\n".into(),
        "alias a = b\nalias b = a\n".into(),
    ] {assert!(!compile(&[("schema.q".into(),source.clone())]).diagnostics.is_empty(),"{source}");}
}
#[test]
fn reports_old_input_breaks_results_and_refusals_and_keeps_required_types() {
    let old=checked("query removed():\n  return true\nquery q(n: int 0..10, obsolete: text <=20):\n  require n != 0 else ZERO\n  return {n}\n");
    let new=checked("query q(n: int 1..9, added: bool):\n  require n != 1 else ONE\n  return {value: n}\n");
    let report=compare(&old,&new,"release 1").join("\n");
    for text in ["removed operation","new required argument added","removed argument obsolete","argument n retyped or narrowed","RESULT REVIEW","BEHAVIOR REVIEW","release 1"] {assert!(report.contains(text),"{text}: {report}");}
    let api=emit::typescript_spanning(&new,&old,2);
    assert!(api.contains("*/ added: boolean"),"{api}");assert!(!api.contains("added?:"));
    let safe=checked("query current(n: int 0..20, obsolete: text <=20 deprecated, added: bool default false):\n  require n != 0 else ZERO\n  return {n}\nalias q = current\nalias removed = constant\nquery constant():\n  return true\n");
    assert!(compare(&old,&safe,"release 1").is_empty(),"{:?}",compare(&old,&safe,"release 1"));
}
#[test]
fn same_named_nominal_rows_still_report_changed_result_fields() {
    let old=checked("table items:\n  n: int\n  public\nquery q(id: items):\n  return items[id]\n");
    let new=checked("table items:\n  n: int\n  label: text <=20 default ''\n  public\nquery q(id: items):\n  return items[id]\n");
    assert!(compare(&old,&new,"release 1").iter().any(|s|s.contains("RESULT REVIEW")));
}

#[test]
fn defaults_and_aliases_have_device_parity_after_backend_json_roundtrip() {
    use snapback4_device::{device::{Backend,Device},memory::MemoryStore};
    let b=checked("query q(n: int default -4, old: bool deprecated):\n  return n\nalias legacy = q\n");
    let backend=Backend{generation:1,schema:b.schema,programs:b.programs.into_iter().map(|p|p.program).collect()};
    let encoded=serde_json::to_string(&backend).unwrap();
    let decoded:Backend=snapback4_core::json_codec::from_text(&encoded).unwrap();
    let mut device=Device::open_store(MemoryStore::new(),Some(decoded)).unwrap();
    for op in ["q","legacy"] {
        for args in [serde_json::json!({}),serde_json::json!({"n":null,"old":true})] {
            assert_eq!(device.query(op,"user:a",&args,0).unwrap().data,Value::Int(-4));
        }
        assert_eq!(device.query(op,"user:a",&serde_json::json!({"n":7}),0).unwrap().data,Value::Int(7));
        assert!(device.query(op,"user:a",&serde_json::json!({"n":"bad"}),0).is_err());
    }
}

   352	            if stage.exists() {std::fs::remove_dir_all(&stage).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;}
   353	            std::fs::create_dir(&stage).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   354	            let _cleanup=Stage(stage.clone());
   355	            std::fs::create_dir(stage.join("snapback")).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   356	            let source_hash = {
   357	                use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
   358	                let mut hash = Sha256::new();
   359	                let mut ordered = sources.iter().collect::<Vec<_>>();
   360	                ordered.sort_by(|a,b| a.0.cmp(&b.0));
   361	                for (name,text) in ordered {
   362	                    hash.update((name.len() as u64).to_le_bytes()); hash.update(name.as_bytes());
   363	                    hash.update((text.len() as u64).to_le_bytes()); hash.update(text.as_bytes());
   364	                }
   365	                format!("{:x}", hash.finalize())
   366	            };
   367	            for (name,text) in sources {
   368	                let path=stage.join("snapback").join(name);
   369	                if let Some(parent)=path.parent(){std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;}
   370	                std::fs::write(path,text).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;
   371	            }
   372	            crate::dev_worker::package(&project, &stage)?;
   373	            // @ref LLP 3000.011.003.000.000#2 — saved schemas prepare companion types in a private snapshot, never in working generated/.
   374	            let private = if options.flags.contains_key("schema") || crate::dev_worker::source(&project).is_some() {
   375	                Some(super::proof_source::Candidate::prepare(&project, &stage, &bound)?)
   376	            } else { None };
   377	            let build_project = private.as_ref().map(|candidate| &candidate.project).unwrap_or(&project);
   378	            // A native job's module travels with the captured source.
   379	            if let Some(built) =
   380	                crate::native::build(build_project, &bound).map_err(|p| p.to_string())?
   381	            {
   382	                let generated = stage.join("snapback").join("generated");
   383	                std::fs::create_dir_all(&generated).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   384	                std::fs::copy(&built.path, generated.join("native.wasm"))
   385	                    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   386	            }
   387	            std::fs::write(stage.join("device-compatibility.json"), serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&snapback4_core::device_protocol::compatibility(&bound.schema.public_projection())).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   388	            crate::dev_worker::package_entry(build_project, &stage)?;
   389	            if let Some(previous)=previous {
   390	                if held["release"].as_u64()==Some(previous) && crate::release_files::digest(&stage)?==crate::release_files::digest(&releases.join(previous.to_string()))? {
   391	                    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&stage).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;
   392	                    if let Some(saved) = &mut saved_version { saved.finish(previous,&source_hash)?; }
   393	                    if options.json {println!("{}",serde_json::json!({"unchanged":true,"release":previous,"generation":held["generation"]}));}
   394	                    else {println!("unchanged; release {previous} stays current as generation {}",held["generation"]);}
   395	                    return Ok(());
   396	                }
   397	            }
   398	            // @ref LLP 3000.000.000#16-release-reactivation-and-rollback-foresight-rel5 — equal retained executable bytes select their existing identity.
   399	            let staged_digest = crate::release_files::digest(&stage)?;
   400	            let mut matching = std::fs::read_dir(&releases).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?
   401	                .filter_map(Result::ok).filter_map(|e| e.file_name().to_str()?.parse::<u64>().ok())
   402	                .filter(|n| selectable(&dir, *n).is_ok())
   403	                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
   404	            matching.sort_unstable_by(|a,b| b.cmp(a));
   405	            let mut matched = None;
   406	            for n in matching {
   407	                if crate::release_files::digest(&releases.join(n.to_string()))? == staged_digest { matched=Some(n); break; }
   408	            }
   409	            if let Some(n) = matched {
   410	                let mut preview_options=options.clone();
   411	                preview_options.flags.insert("deploy-direction".into(),String::new());
   412	                preview_options.flags.insert("restore-dormant".into(),String::new());
   413	                if !checking { preview_options.flags.insert("validation-only".into(),String::new()); }
   414	                super::release_preview::preview(&dir.join("store.sqlite"),releases.join(n.to_string()),n,&preview_options)?;
   415	                if checking { return Ok(()); }
   416	                let selected = bound_at(releases.join(n.to_string()))?;
   417	                activate(&dir,_deployment.as_ref(),n,previous,revision,selected,false,true,options.flags.contains_key("allow-feed-adoption"),options)?;
   418	                if let Some(saved)=&mut saved_version {saved.finish(n,&source_hash)?;}
   419	                return Ok(());
   420	            }
   421	            let mut n=std::fs::read_dir(&releases).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?.filter_map(Result::ok).filter_map(|e|e.file_name().to_str()?.parse::<u64>().ok()).max().unwrap_or(0);
   422	            let staged_bound = bound_at(stage.clone())?;
   423	            if options.flags.contains_key("check") {
   424	                let mut preview_options=options.clone();preview_options.flags.insert("deploy-direction".into(),String::new());
   425	                let result=super::release_preview::preview(&dir.join("store.sqlite"),stage.clone(),n.checked_add(1).ok_or("release identity exhausted")?,&preview_options);
   426	                let _=std::fs::remove_dir_all(&stage);
   427	                return result;
   428	            }
   429	            let mut validation=options.clone();
   430	            validation.flags.insert("deploy-direction".into(),String::new());
   431	            validation.flags.insert("validation-only".into(),String::new());
   432	            super::release_preview::preview(&dir.join("store.sqlite"),stage.clone(),n.checked_add(1).ok_or("release identity exhausted")?,&validation)?;
   433	            if staged_bound.schema != bound.schema { return Err("staged source does not match the compiled schema".into()); }
   434	            n=n.checked_add(1).ok_or("release identity exhausted")?;
   435	            let final_dir=releases.join(n.to_string());
   436	            // @ref LLP 3000.000.000#10-wave-10-release-lifecycle-amendment — only committed adoption makes a candidate selectable.
   437	            std::fs::write(stage.join(".pending-adoption"), b"pending\n").map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;
   438	            if staged_bound.schema != bound.schema {
   439	                return Err("staged source does not match the compiled schema".into());
   440	            }
   441	            // @ref LLP 3000.000.000.000.000#4-cli-surface-contracts — provenance is immutable metadata, excluded from executable identity so identical deploys stay no-ops.
   442	            std::fs::write(stage.join("provenance.json"), format!("{}\n", serde_json::json!({
   443	                "release": n, "sourceHash": source_hash, "cliVersion": env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"), "createdAt": snapback4_core::now_ms()
   444	            }))).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;
   445	            crate::release_files::durable(&stage)?;
   446	            std::fs::rename(&stage, &final_dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   447	            let mut candidate=crate::release_files::Candidate::new(&dir,n);
   448	            std::fs::File::open(&releases)
   449	                .and_then(|f| f.sync_all())
   450	                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   451	            let result=activate(
   452	                &dir,
   453	                _deployment.as_ref(),
   454	                n,
   455	                previous,
   456	                revision,
   457	                staged_bound,
   458	                false,
   459	                options.flags.contains_key("restore-dormant"),
   460	                options.flags.contains_key("allow-feed-adoption"),
   461	                options,
   462	            );
   463	            match result {
   464	                Ok(()) => {
   465	                    candidate.committed=true;
   466	                    if let Err(error)=std::fs::remove_file(final_dir.join(".pending-adoption")) {eprintln!("release {n} committed; pending-marker cleanup failed: {error}; history proves adoption");}
   467	                    if let Some(saved) = &mut saved_version {saved.finish(n,&source_hash).map_err(|e|format!("release {n} committed, but saving its snapshot failed: {e}; retry unchanged deploy with --save-version"))?;}
   468	                }
   469	                Err(error) => {
   470	                    if options.json && error.contains("dormant names") {
   471	                        let mut inventory=Vec::new();let mut cursor=None;
   472	                        loop {
   473	                            let page=status(&dir,_deployment.as_ref(),0,cursor,None)?;
   474	                            let items=page["items"].as_array().ok_or("invalid dormant inventory response")?;
   475	                            if items.is_empty() {break;}
   476	                            inventory.extend(items.iter().cloned());
   477	                            cursor=items.last().and_then(|i|i["key"].as_str()).map(str::to_owned);
   478	                            if cursor.is_none() {break;}
   479	                        }
   480	                        println!("{}",serde_json::json!({"ok":false,"code":"E_ADOPT","message":error,"dormant":inventory}));
   481	                    }
   482	                    return Err(error);
   483	                }
   484	            }
   485	            Ok(())
   486	        })(),
   487	    )
   488	}

   490	pub fn rollback(options: &Options) -> i32 {
   491	    report(
   492	        "rollback",
   493	        (|| {
   494	            let dir = existing_deployment(&directory(options)?)?;
   495	            let _command = command_lock(&dir)?;
   496	            let _deployment = target(&dir)?;
   497	            if let Some(owner) = &_deployment { owner.report_reclaim(options.flags.contains_key("verbose")); }
   498	            let held = status(&dir, _deployment.as_ref(), 0, None, None)?;
   499	            let active = if let Some(owner) = _deployment.as_ref() {
   500	                current(&dir, owner)?
   501	            } else {
   502	                held["release"].as_u64()
   503	            }
   504	            .ok_or("no current release")?;
   505	            let revision = held["revision"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0);
   506	            let selected = options
   507	                .flags
   508	                .get("to")
   509	                .map(|n| {
   510	                    if n=="latest" {return latest(&dir).map_err(|_| "no complete latest release");}
   511	                    n.parse::<u64>()
   512	                        .ok()
   513	                        .filter(|n| *n > 0)
   514	                        .ok_or("--to requires a positive immutable release id")
   515	                })
   516	                .transpose()?;
   517	            let previous = selected
   518	                .or_else(|| held["previous_active"].as_u64())
   519	                .ok_or("nothing to roll back to")?;
   520	            selectable(&dir, previous)?;
   521	            let bound = bound_at(dir.join("releases").join(previous.to_string()))?;
   522	            // @ref LLP 3000.000.000#14-wave-14-rollback-narration — resolve bare/latest selection visibly before any preview or live activation.
   523	            let target_line=format!("resolved rollback target: release {previous} (current release {active})");
   524	            if options.json {eprintln!("{target_line}");} else {println!("{target_line}");}
   525	            check_change(&dir, Some(active), &bound, options, Some(previous))?;
   526	            if options.flags.contains_key("check") {
   527	                return super::release_preview::preview(&dir.join("store.sqlite"),dir.join("releases").join(previous.to_string()),previous,options);
   528	            }
   529	            activate(
   530	                &dir,
   531	                _deployment.as_ref(),
   532	                previous,
   533	                Some(active),
   534	                revision,
   535	                bound,
   536	                true,
   537	                true,
   538	                options.flags.contains_key("allow-feed-adoption"),
   539	                options,
   540	            )?;
   541	
   542	            Ok(())
   543	        })(),
   544	    )
   545	}

   547	pub fn releases(options: &Options) -> i32 {
   548	    report(
   549	        "releases",
   550	        (|| {
   551	            let dir = existing_deployment(&directory(options)?)?;
   552	            let after = options
   553	                .flags
   554	                .get("after")
   555	                .map(|s| s.parse::<u64>().map_err(|_| "--after requires an event id"))
   556	                .transpose()?
   557	                .unwrap_or(0);
   558	            let event = options
   559	                .flags
   560	                .get("event")
   561	                .map(|s| s.parse::<u64>().map_err(|_| "--event requires an event id"))
   562	                .transpose()?;
   563	            // Read-only inspection needs no ownership handoff or source adoption.
   564	            let mut store = snapback4_core::Store::open_read_only(&dir.join("store.sqlite"))
   565	                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   566	            let mut result = store
   567	                .release_status(
   568	                    after,
   569	                    options.flags.get("items-after").map(String::as_str),
   570	                    event,
   571	                )
   572	                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   573	            if result["release"].is_null() { result["release"]=serde_json::json!(inspect_current(&dir)?); }
   574	            result["current"]=result["release"].clone();
   575	            result["latest"]=serde_json::json!(latest(&dir).ok());
   576	            if let Some(selector)=options.positionals.get(1) {
   577	                let n=if selector=="latest" {latest(&dir)?} else if selector=="current" {result["release"].as_u64().ok_or("no current release")?} else {selector.parse::<u64>().ok().filter(|n|*n>0).ok_or("releases selection requires N, latest or current")?};
   578	                selectable(&dir,n)?;let root=dir.join("releases").join(n.to_string());bound_at(root.clone())?;
   579	                result["selected"]=serde_json::json!({"release":n,"current":result["release"].as_u64()==Some(n),"digest":crate::release_files::digest(&root)?});
   580	            }
   581	            println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&result).unwrap());
   582	            Ok(())
   583	        })(),
   584	    )
   585	}

   587	pub fn prune(options: &Options) -> i32 {
   588	    report(
   589	        "prune",
   590	        (|| {
   591	            let dir = existing_deployment(&directory(options)?)?;
   592	            let _command = command_lock(&dir)?;
   593	            let owner = target(&dir)?;
   594	            let held = status(&dir, owner.as_ref(), 0, None, None)?;
   595	            let revision = held["revision"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0);
   596	            let confirm = options.flags.contains_key("allow-destructive");
   597	            let result = match owner.as_ref() {
   598	                Some(owner) => owner
   599	                    .open_store(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5))
   600	                    .and_then(|mut s| s.prune_dormant(confirm, Some(revision)))
   601	                    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?,
   602	                None => crate::release_control::request(
   603	                    &dir,
   604	                    crate::release_control::Command::Prune {
   605	                        confirm,
   606	                        expected_revision: revision,
   607	                    },
   608	                )?,
   609	            };
   610	            println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&result).unwrap());
   611	            // Live responses are bounded. Enumerate the committed audit set (or
   612	            // current preview) to name every item, never silently omit a drop.
   613	            if owner.is_none() {
   614	                let mut after = result["items_after"].as_str().map(str::to_owned);
   615	                while let Some(key) = after {
   616	                    let page = status(&dir, None, 0, Some(key), result["event"].as_u64())?;
   617	                    let items = page["items"].as_array().ok_or("invalid inventory reply")?;
   618	                    if items.is_empty() {
   619	                        break;
   620	                    }
   621	                    println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(items).unwrap());
   622	                    after = page["items_after"].as_str().map(str::to_owned);
   623	                }
   624	            }
   625	            if !confirm {
   626	                println!(
   627	                    "preview only; to permanently drop this dormant storage: snapback4 prune {} --allow-destructive",
   628	                    dir.display()
   629	                );
   630	            }
   631	            Ok(())
   632	        })(),
   633	    )
   634	}

   636	pub fn serve_release(options: &Options) -> Result<(), String> {
   637	    let requested_port = crate::port_flag::parse("serve", options.flags.get("port").map(String::as_str))?;
   638	    let bind = release_bind(options)?;
   639	    let capacity = crate::host_limits::Capacity::from_options(&options.flags, |name| {
   640	        std::env::var(name).ok()
   641	    })?;
   642	    let dir = existing_deployment(&directory(options)?)?;
   643	    crate::host_limits::initialize();
   644	    let owner = crate::store_owner::host(&dir.join("store.sqlite"))?;
   645	    owner.report_reclaim(options.flags.contains_key("verbose"));
   646	    let current = current(&dir, &owner)?.ok_or("no current release; deploy first")?;
   647	    let release = Project {
   648	        root: dir.join("releases").join(current.to_string())
   649	            .canonicalize().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?,
   650	    };
   651	    crate::release_files::link_store(&release.root)?;
   652	    let (port, listener) = crate::port_flag::listen("serve", requested_port, bind, None)?;
   653	    let worker = options
   654	        .flags
   655	        .get("worker")
   656	        .map(|path| {
   657	            Path::new(path)
   658	                .canonicalize()
   659	                .map_err(|e| format!("--worker {path}: {e}"))
   660	        })
   661	        .transpose()?;
   662	    crate::serve::serve(
   663	        release,
   664	        port,
   665	        crate::serve::Mode::Release {
   666	            expected: current,
   667	            worker,
   668	            owner: std::sync::Arc::new(owner),
   669	        },
   670	        &bind.to_string(),
   671	        listener,
   672	        capacity,
   673	    )
   674	}
   675	
   676	pub(crate) fn release_bind(options: &Options) -> Result<std::net::IpAddr, String> {
   677	    let bind = options
   678	        .flags
   679	        .get("bind")
   680	        .map(String::as_str)
   681	        .unwrap_or("127.0.0.1");
   682	    let address: std::net::IpAddr = bind
   683	        .parse()
   684	        .map_err(|_| "--bind must be a literal IPv4 or IPv6 address".to_owned())?;
   685	    if !address.is_loopback() {
   686	        if !options.flags.contains_key("i-understand-cleartext") {
   687	            return Err("non-loopback HTTP sends passwords and bearer tokens in cleartext; use a loopback listener behind a TLS proxy, or explicitly pass --i-understand-cleartext".into());
   688	        }
   689	        eprintln!(
   690	            "WARNING: listening on {address} over CLEARTEXT HTTP. Passwords, bearer tokens, schema and data have no transport protection. Expose only through a TLS proxy on a trusted private hop; see snapback4/README.md."
   691	        );
   692	    }
   693	    Ok(address)
   694	}

   699	    #[test]
   700	    fn deployment_startup_resolves_new_paths_and_existing_aliases() {
   701	        use std::os::unix::fs::{symlink, PermissionsExt};
   702	        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("sb4-canonical-release-{}-{}",
   703	            std::process::id(), std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap().as_nanos()));
   704	        std::fs::create_dir(&root).unwrap();
   705	        struct Cleanup(std::path::PathBuf);
   706	        impl Drop for Cleanup { fn drop(&mut self) { let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&self.0); } }
   707	        let _cleanup = Cleanup(root.clone());
   708	        let options = |path: &std::path::Path| super::parse(&["deploy".into(), path.to_str().unwrap().into()]);
   709	        let target = root.join("deployment");
   710	        let canonical = super::canonical_directory(&options(&target)).unwrap();
   711	        assert_eq!(canonical, target.canonicalize().unwrap());
   712	        assert_eq!(std::fs::metadata(&canonical).unwrap().permissions().mode() & 0o777, 0o700);
   713	        let alias = root.join("alias");
   714	        symlink(&target, &alias).unwrap();
   715	        assert_eq!(super::canonical_directory(&options(&alias)).unwrap(), canonical);
   716	        let nested = alias.join("nested");
   717	        assert_eq!(super::canonical_directory(&options(&nested)).unwrap(), canonical.join("nested"));
   718	        let file = root.join("file"); std::fs::write(&file, "preserved").unwrap();
   719	        assert!(super::canonical_directory(&options(&file)).is_err());
   720	        assert_eq!(std::fs::read_to_string(file).unwrap(), "preserved");
   721	    }

fn command_lock(dir: &Path) -> Result<std::fs::File, String> {
    #[cfg(unix)]
    {
        let file = snapback4_core::private_fs::auxiliary_file(
            &dir.join("store.sqlite"),
            &dir.join(".release-command"),
            true,
            0,
        )
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        file.lock().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        Ok(file)
    }
    #[cfg(not(unix))]
    Err("release commands require Unix".into())
}
fn target(dir: &Path) -> Result<Option<Owner>, String> {
    match deployment_lock(dir) {
        Ok(owner) => Ok(Some(owner)),
        Err(error) if error.contains("E_STORE_BUSY") => Ok(None),
        Err(error) => Err(error),
    }
}
fn status(
    dir: &Path,
    owner: Option<&Owner>,
    after: u64,
    items_after: Option<String>,
    event: Option<u64>,
) -> Result<serde_json::Value, String> {
    match owner {
        Some(owner) => owner
            .open_store(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5))
            .and_then(|mut s| s.release_status(after, items_after.as_deref(), event))
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string()),
        None => crate::release_control::request(
            dir,
            crate::release_control::Command::Status {
                after,
                items_after,
                event,
            },
        ),
    }
}
fn activate(
    dir: &Path,
    owner: Option<&Owner>,
    release: u64,
    previous: Option<u64>,
    revision: u64,
    bound: snapback4_lang::Bound,
    rollback: bool,
    restore_dormant: bool,
    allow_feed_adoption: bool,
    options: &Options,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let root = dir.join("releases").join(release.to_string());
    let digest = crate::release_files::digest(&root)?;
    if let Some(owner) = owner {
        let project = Project { root };
        let prepared = crate::native::prepare(&project, &bound).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        crate::dev_worker::prepare_release(&project, &bound.schema)?;
        crate::release_files::link_store(&project.root)?;
        crate::release_files::durable(&project.root)?;
        let mut pointer = crate::release_files::Pointer::prepare(dir, release, previous, rollback)?;
        let activation = snapback4_core::engine::release::ReleaseActivation {
            release,
            expected_previous: previous,
            expected_revision: Some(revision),
            restore_dormant,
            native_digest: prepared.installed.as_ref().map(|m| m.digest.clone()),
            operation: if rollback { "rollback" } else { "deploy" }.into(),
        };
        let store = owner
            .open_store(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5))
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let engine = snapback4_core::Engine::new_release_prepared(
            store,
            bound.schema,
            bound.programs.into_iter().map(|p| p.program),
            &activation,
            allow_feed_adoption,
        )
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        pointer.finish(engine.generation())?;
        receipt(release,engine.generation(),&engine.store().adoption_report,options);

    } else {
        let result = crate::release_control::request(
            dir,
            crate::release_control::Command::Activate {
                release,
                expected_release: previous,
                expected_revision: revision,
                digest,
                rollback,
                restore_dormant,
                allow_feed_adoption,
            },
        )?;
        if options.json {println!("{}",result);} else {
            println!("release {release} is current as generation {}; {}; running serve adopted the release",result["generation"],result["adoption"].as_str().unwrap_or("adopted"));
            for fill in result["backfills"].as_array().into_iter().flatten().filter_map(|f|f.as_str()) {println!("  backfill: {fill}");}
            if options.flags.contains_key("verbose") {println!("{}",result["details"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));}
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn report(verb: &str, result: Result<(), String>) -> i32 {
    // @ref LLP 3000#contended-read-serving — release completion owns no engine/lease; bound the final diagnostic drain.
    // The background writer must get a chance to emit adoption estimates before
    // this short-lived command exits. Broken/stalled output cannot hold exit.
    let _ = snapback4_core::diagnostics::drain(std::time::Duration::from_secs(3));
    match result {
        Ok(()) => 0,
        Err(error) => {
            eprintln!("{verb}: {error}");
            1
        }
    }
}

    let mut engine = snapback4_core::Engine::new_release_prepared(
        store,
        bound.schema,
        bound.programs.into_iter().map(|p| p.program),
        &activation,
        options.flags.contains_key("allow-feed-adoption"),
    )
    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut planned = engine
        .store_mut()
        .release_status(0, None, None)
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    planned["items"] = serde_json::to_value(
        engine
            .store_mut()
            .dormant_inventory(None, usize::MAX)
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?,
    )
    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let items: Vec<snapback4_core::store::DormantItem> = serde_json::from_value(planned["items"].clone()).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut effects = super::release_safeguards::warnings(engine.store(),prior_schema.as_ref(),&candidate_schema,&candidate_programs,&items,release,!options.flags.contains_key("deploy-direction"))?;
    effects.append(&mut hazards); hazards=effects;
    for fill in &engine.store().adoption_report.backfills { notes.push(format!("backfill: {fill}; confirm these historical values before selecting release {release}")); }
    steps.retain(|step|!step.message.contains("engine capture"));
    for step in &mut steps {
        if step.change==snapback4_core::successor::Change::Narrowing {
            step.change=snapback4_core::successor::Change::Additive;
            step.message=format!("{}; active rows satisfy the candidate after dormant projection",step.message.split(';').next().unwrap_or(&step.message));
        }
        if let Some(position)=step.path.strip_prefix("maintains[").and_then(|s|s.strip_suffix(']')).and_then(|s|s.parse::<usize>().ok()) {
            let label=candidate_schema.maintains[position].label();
            let visits=engine.store().adoption_report.views.iter().find(|view|view.name==label).map(|v|v.rows).unwrap_or(0);
            step.message=format!("maintain {label}: rebuilt from {visits} source rows");
            step.change=snapback4_core::successor::Change::Additive;
        }
        let path=step.path.strip_prefix("tables.").unwrap_or(&step.path).replace(".columns.",".");
        let count=planned["items"].as_array().into_iter().flatten().find(|i|i["path"].as_str()==Some(path.as_str())).and_then(|i|i["rows"].as_u64()).unwrap_or(0);
        let unit = if step.path.contains(".columns.") { "cells" } else if step.path.contains(".indexes.") { "entries" } else { "rows" };
        // @ref LLP 3000.000.000#11-wave-11-factual-release-narration — per-path prose uses the same disjoint counts as the inventory totals.
        let retained = if count == 0 && unit == "cells" {
            format!("no standalone {unit} become dormant (cells of any dormant rows are counted with those rows)")
        } else if count == 0 {
            format!("no {unit} become dormant")
        } else {
            format!("its {unit} become dormant ({count} {unit}; restored on forward)")
        };
        step.message=step.message.replace("its rows are lost", &retained).replace("its values are lost", &retained);
    }
    if options.flags.contains_key("deploy-direction") {
        if let Some(current) = held["release"].as_u64() {
            let old_root=store_path.parent().ok_or("no deployment directory")?.join("releases").join(current.to_string());
            let old=super::releases::bound_at(old_root.clone())?;
            hazards.extend(super::rollback_foresight::risks(&candidate_schema,&old.schema,current,store_path.parent().unwrap()));
            // Exact reverse adoption tests today's post-deploy image, separately from future-write risks.
            let reverse_path=snapshot.0.join("reverse.sqlite");
            engine.store().conn().execute("VACUUM INTO ?1",[reverse_path.to_string_lossy().as_ref()]).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;
            let reverse_store=snapback4_core::Store::open(&reverse_path).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;
            let native=crate::native::prepare(&Project {root:old_root},&old).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;
            let mut reverse=snapback4_core::engine::release::ReleaseActivation::new(current,Some(release));
            reverse.restore_dormant=true;
            reverse.native_digest=native.installed.map(|m|m.digest);
            reverse.operation="preview".into();
            if let Err(error)=snapback4_core::Engine::new_release_prepared(reverse_store,old.schema,old.programs.into_iter().map(|p|p.program),&reverse,options.flags.contains_key("allow-feed-adoption")) {
                hazards.push(format!("rollback to release {current} refuses on the post-deploy snapshot: {error}; run `snapback4 rollback {} --to {current} --check --bridge <new-dir>` and preserve the required fields/domains in a bridge",store_path.parent().unwrap().display()));
            }
        }
    }
    hazards.extend(client_compatibility.iter().cloned());
    if options.flags.contains_key("validation-only") {
        for hazard in &hazards { eprintln!("WARNING {hazard}"); }
        return Ok(());
    }
    let checklist = super::release_bridge::checklist(held["release"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0),release,&hazards);
    if let Some(path) = options.flags.get("bridge") {
        let current = held["release"].as_u64().ok_or("a bridge needs a current deployed release")?;
        super::release_bridge::write(Path::new(path),store_path.parent().ok_or("no deployment directory")?,current,release,&checklist)?;
        eprintln!("bridge starter written to {path}; edit its current source and follow ROLLBACK-CHECKLIST.md before activation");
    }
    if options.json {
        println!("{}",serde_json::to_string_pretty(&serde_json::json!({"preview":true,"clientCompatibility":client_compatibility,"checklist":checklist,"hazards":hazards,"notes":notes,"current":held,"plan":planned,"steps":steps,"estimate":estimate,"phases":engine.store().adoption_report.summary(),"backfills":engine.store().adoption_report.backfills})).unwrap());
    } else {
        println!("preview: release {release} would be current as generation {}; live release unchanged", engine.generation());
        super::release_summary::print(prior_schema.as_ref(), &candidate_schema, &candidate_programs, &hazards, &notes, &steps, &items);
        if !options.flags.contains_key("deploy-direction") { println!("  checklist: prove the named refusal cases and affected lists/counts as real accounts before release {release}; `--bridge <new-dir>` saves current source plus this app's ROLLBACK-CHECKLIST.md"); }
        println!("  storage: {}",snapback4_core::store::adoption_report::AdoptionReport::dormant(&items));
        if options.flags.contains_key("verbose") {
            for hazard in hazards { println!("  detail: WARNING {hazard}"); }
            for note in notes { println!("  detail: note: {note}"); }
            for step in steps {println!("  {}: {}",step.path,step.message);}
            for item in &items { println!("  {}: {} {} dormant (restored on compatible forward); sample ids [{}]", item.key, item.rows, item.unit(), item.sample_ids.join(", ")); }
            println!("{}", engine.store().adoption_report.summary());
            if let Some(estimate) = estimate {
                println!("{estimate}");
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
//! Immutable release custody: digest the required tree and flush it before DB selection.
// @ref LLP 3000.000.000#5-hot-activation-and-ownership — source durability precedes the database's release pointer.
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::{
    fs,
    io::{Read, Write},
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
};

fn files(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut Vec<PathBuf>) -> Result<(), String> {
    let mut entries = fs::read_dir(path)
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .map(|e| e.map(|e| e.path()).map_err(|e| e.to_string()))
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
    entries.sort();
    for path in entries {
        let relative = path.strip_prefix(root).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        if relative
            .components()
            .next()
            .is_some_and(|c| c.as_os_str() == ".snapback4")
        {
            continue;
        }
        let m = fs::symlink_metadata(&path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        if m.is_dir() {
            files(root, &path, out)?;
        } else if m.is_file() {
            out.push(path);
        } else {
            return Err(format!(
                "immutable release artifact must be a real directory or regular file: {}",
                path.display()
            ));
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
pub(crate) fn digest(root: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
    let mut paths = Vec::new();
    files(root, root, &mut paths)?;
    let mut hash = Sha256::new();
    for path in paths {
        let name = path.strip_prefix(root).unwrap().to_string_lossy();
        // @ref LLP 3000.000.000.000.000#4-cli-surface-contracts — metadata does not change executable release identity.
        if name == ".pending-adoption" || name == "provenance.json" {continue;}
        hash.update((name.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
        hash.update(name.as_bytes());
        #[cfg(unix)]
        use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
        let mut options = fs::OpenOptions::new();
        options.read(true);
        #[cfg(unix)]
        options.custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW);
        let mut file = options.open(&path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        hash.update(
            file.metadata()
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
                .len()
                .to_le_bytes(),
        );
        let mut buffer = [0u8; 16384];
        loop {
            let n = file.read(&mut buffer).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            if n == 0 {
                break;
            }
            hash.update(&buffer[..n]);
        }
    }
    Ok(format!("{:x}", hash.finalize()))
}
pub(crate) fn durable(root: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    let mut paths = Vec::new();
    files(root, root, &mut paths)?;
    for path in paths {
        fs::File::open(path)
            .and_then(|f| f.sync_all())
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    }
    fn dirs(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
        for e in fs::read_dir(path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())? {
            let e = e.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            if e.file_type().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?.is_dir() {
                dirs(&e.path())?;
            }
        }
        fs::File::open(path)
            .and_then(|f| f.sync_all())
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
    }
    dirs(root)
}

pub(crate) fn link_store(root: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    let project = crate::project::Project { root: root.into() };
    snapback4_core::private_fs::directory(&project.data_dir()).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let path = project.store_path();
    #[cfg(unix)]
    {
        let target = Path::new("../../../store.sqlite");
        match fs::symlink_metadata(&path) {
            Ok(m) if m.file_type().is_symlink() => {
                if fs::read_link(&path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())? != target {
                    fs::remove_file(&path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                    std::os::unix::fs::symlink(target, &path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                }
            }
            Ok(_) => {
                return Err(format!(
                    "release store path must be a symbolic link: {}",
                    path.display()
                ));
            }
            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
                std::os::unix::fs::symlink(target, &path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
            }
            Err(e) => return Err(e.to_string()),
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    #[cfg(not(unix))]
    Err("serving shared releases requires Unix symbolic links".into())
}

pub(crate) struct Pointer {
    staged: PathBuf,
    dir: PathBuf,
    release: u64,
    previous: Option<u64>,
    rollback: bool,
    ledger: fs::File,
}
impl Pointer {
    pub(crate) fn prepare(
        dir: &Path,
        release: u64,
        previous: Option<u64>,
        rollback: bool,
    ) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let pointer = dir.join("current");
        if pointer.exists() && !pointer.is_file() {
            return Err("current must be a regular release pointer file".into());
        }
        let staged = dir.join(format!(".current-{}-{release}", std::process::id()));
        let file = snapback4_core::private_fs::file(&staged, true).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let mut prepared = Self {
            staged,
            dir: dir.into(),
            release,
            previous,
            rollback,
            ledger: file,
        };
        writeln!(prepared.ledger, "{release}")
            .and_then(|_| prepared.ledger.sync_all())
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        prepared.ledger = fs::OpenOptions::new()
            .create(true)
            .append(true)
            .open(dir.join("releases.jsonl"))
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        writeln!(prepared.ledger,"{}",serde_json::json!({"at":snapback4_core::now_ms(),"release":release,"previous":previous,"rollback":rollback,"state":"prepared"})).and_then(|_|prepared.ledger.sync_all()).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;
        Ok(prepared)
    }
    pub(crate) fn finish(&mut self, generation: u64) -> Result<(), String> {
        fs::rename(&self.staged,self.dir.join("current")).and_then(|_|fs::File::open(&self.dir)?.sync_all()).map_err(|e|format!("release {} committed in database, but current copy failed: {e}; inspect `snapback4 releases {}`",self.release,self.dir.display()))?;
        writeln!(self.ledger,"{}",serde_json::json!({"at":snapback4_core::now_ms(),"release":self.release,"previous":self.previous,"rollback":self.rollback,"generation":generation,"state":"activated"})).and_then(|_|self.ledger.sync_all()).map_err(|e|format!("release committed, but ledger completion failed: {e}"))
    }
}
impl Drop for Pointer {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if self.staged.exists() {
            let _ = fs::remove_file(&self.staged);
        }
    }
}

// @ref LLP 3000.000.000#16-release-reactivation-and-rollback-foresight-rel5 — deletion requires a definitive non-commit, never a lost reply.
pub(crate) struct Candidate { dir: PathBuf, release: u64, pub committed: bool }
impl Candidate {
    pub(crate) fn new(dir: &Path, release: u64) -> Self { Self {dir:dir.into(),release,committed:false} }
}
impl Drop for Candidate {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if self.committed { return; }
        let probe=(|| -> Result<bool,String> {
            let store=snapback4_core::Store::open_read_only(&self.dir.join("store.sqlite")).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;
            let history:bool=store.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type='table' AND name='_release_events')",[],|r|r.get(0)).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;
            if !history {return Ok(false);}
            store.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _release_events WHERE release=?1 OR previous=?1)",[self.release as i64],|r|r.get(0)).map_err(|e|e.to_string())
        })();
        match probe {
            Ok(false)=>if let Err(e)=fs::remove_dir_all(self.dir.join("releases").join(self.release.to_string())) {eprintln!("uncommitted release {} cleanup failed: {e}",self.release);},
            Ok(true)=>{},
            Err(e)=>eprintln!("release {} outcome unknown; retained source for recovery; inspect releases: {e}",self.release),
        }
    }
}

//! Private filesystem-owner control transport; never an HTTP application door.
// @ref LLP 3000.000.000#5-hot-activation-and-ownership — the host remains the only database writer.
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::{Value, json};
#[cfg(unix)]
use std::os::unix::{
    ffi::OsStrExt,
    fs::{DirBuilderExt, FileTypeExt, MetadataExt, OpenOptionsExt, PermissionsExt},
    net::{UnixListener, UnixStream},
};
use std::{
    fs,
    io::{self, Read, Write},
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

const INPUT: usize = 4096;
const OUTPUT: usize = 64 * 1024;

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "command", rename_all = "kebab-case", deny_unknown_fields)]
pub(crate) enum Command {
    Status {
        after: u64,
        items_after: Option<String>,
        event: Option<u64>,
    },
    Activate {
        release: u64,
        expected_release: Option<u64>,
        expected_revision: u64,
        digest: String,
        rollback: bool,
        restore_dormant: bool,
        allow_feed_adoption: bool,
    },
    Prune {
        confirm: bool,
        expected_revision: u64,
    },
}
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct Envelope {
    identity: String,
    command: Command,
}

#[cfg(unix)]
pub(crate) fn identity(store: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
    let path = store.canonicalize().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let m = snapback4_core::private_fs::database_metadata(&path)
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .ok_or("store disappeared")?;
    Ok(crate::native::digest(
        &serde_json::to_vec(&(path.as_os_str().as_bytes(), m.dev(), m.ino())).unwrap(),
    ))
}

#[cfg(unix)]
fn peer(stream: &UnixStream) -> io::Result<()> {
    use std::os::fd::AsRawFd;
    #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
    let uid = {
        let mut credentials = std::mem::MaybeUninit::<libc::ucred>::uninit();
        let mut size = std::mem::size_of::<libc::ucred>() as libc::socklen_t;
        if unsafe {
            libc::getsockopt(
                stream.as_raw_fd(),
                libc::SOL_SOCKET,
                libc::SO_PEERCRED,
                credentials.as_mut_ptr().cast(),
                &mut size,
            )
        } != 0
        {
            return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
        }
        if size as usize != std::mem::size_of::<libc::ucred>() {
            return Err(io::Error::other("invalid peer credentials"));
        }
        unsafe { credentials.assume_init() }.uid
    };
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    let uid = {
        let (mut uid, mut gid) = (0, 0);
        if unsafe { libc::getpeereid(stream.as_raw_fd(), &mut uid, &mut gid) } != 0 {
            return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
        }
        uid
    };
    #[cfg(not(any(target_os = "linux", target_os = "macos")))]
    return Err(io::Error::other(
        "release control peer credentials unsupported on this Unix host",
    ));
    #[cfg(any(target_os = "linux", target_os = "macos"))]
    if uid != unsafe { libc::geteuid() } {
        return Err(io::Error::other(
            "release control requires the same filesystem owner",
        ));
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(unix)]
fn socket_entry(path: &Path) -> io::Result<fs::Metadata> {
    let m = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
    if !m.file_type().is_socket()
        || m.uid() != unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
        || m.permissions().mode() & 0o7777 != 0o600
    {
        return Err(io::Error::other(
            "release control must be a same-owner 0600 socket, never a symlink or regular file",
        ));
    }
    Ok(m)
}

// @ref LLP 3000.000.000#51-path-independent-control-address — fixed short runtime root, independent of shell environment.
#[cfg(unix)]
fn private_directory(path: &Path, create: bool) -> io::Result<()> {
    if create {
        match fs::DirBuilder::new().mode(0o700).create(path) {
            Ok(()) => {}
            Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => {}
            Err(e) => return Err(e),
        }
    }
    // Do not chmod or follow an existing entry. A stranger can pre-create a
    // name in /tmp, but cannot turn that into a capability or chmod target.
    let directory = fs::OpenOptions::new()
        .read(true)
        .custom_flags(libc::O_DIRECTORY | libc::O_NOFOLLOW)
        .open(path)?;
    directory_metadata(&directory.metadata()?, unsafe { libc::geteuid() })
}

#[cfg(unix)]
fn directory_metadata(m: &fs::Metadata, uid: u32) -> io::Result<()> {
    if !m.is_dir() || m.uid() != uid || m.permissions().mode() & 0o7777 != 0o700 {
        return Err(io::Error::other(
            "release control runtime directory must be a same-owner 0700 directory",
        ));
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(unix)]
fn address(dir: &Path, create: bool) -> io::Result<PathBuf> {
    let directory = PathBuf::from(format!("/tmp/snapback4-{}", unsafe { libc::geteuid() }));
    private_directory(&directory, create)?;
    let canonical = dir.canonicalize()?;
    // Bind the address to immutable deployment source, even when two
    // deployments symlink their database to the same store. The actual
    // database path/inode is separately checked in every envelope.
    Ok(directory.join(format!(
        "{}.sock",
        crate::native::digest(canonical.as_os_str().as_bytes())
    )))
}

// @ref LLP 3000.000.000#51-path-independent-control-address — a total input deadline bounds shutdown even when a peer keeps sending bytes.
#[cfg(unix)]
fn input(stream: &mut UnixStream, timeout: Duration) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
    let deadline = Instant::now() + timeout;
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    let mut buffer = [0; INPUT + 1];
    while bytes.len() <= INPUT {
        let remaining = deadline.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now());
        if remaining.is_zero() {
            return Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,
                "release control input deadline exceeded",
            ));
        }
        stream.set_read_timeout(Some(remaining))?;
        match stream.read(&mut buffer[..INPUT + 1 - bytes.len()]) {
            Ok(0) => break,
            Ok(n) => bytes.extend_from_slice(&buffer[..n]),
            Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
            Err(e) => return Err(e),
        }
    }
    Ok(bytes)
}

/// Only called while the exclusive database sidecar is held, so stale socket
/// replacement cannot disconnect another admitted serving owner.
#[cfg(unix)]
pub(crate) struct Listener {
    listener: UnixListener,
    path: PathBuf,
    inode: (u64, u64),
    identity: String,
}
#[cfg(unix)]
impl Listener {
    pub(crate) fn bind(dir: &Path, store: &Path) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let identity = identity(store)?;
        let path = address(dir, true).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

            Ok(_) => {
                socket_entry(&path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                match UnixStream::connect(&path) {
                    Ok(_) => {
                        return Err("release control socket already has a live listener".into());
                    }
                    Err(e)
                        if matches!(
                            e.kind(),
                            io::ErrorKind::ConnectionRefused | io::ErrorKind::NotFound
                        ) => {}
                    Err(e) => return Err(e.to_string()),
                }
                fs::remove_file(&path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        }

            .map_err(|e| format!("release control {}: {e}", path.display()))?;

        let owned = Self {
            listener,
            path,
            inode: (m.dev(), m.ino()),
            identity,
        };
        // Establish cleanup custody before any fallible setup after bind.

            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        owned
            .listener
            .set_nonblocking(true)
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        socket_entry(&owned.path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        Ok(owned)
    }
    fn accept(&self) -> io::Result<UnixStream> {
        let (stream, _) = self.listener.accept()?;
        // Darwin inherits O_NONBLOCK from the listener; input's deadline and
        // socket timeouts require blocking I/O, even before the client writes.
        stream.set_nonblocking(false)?;
        Ok(stream)
    }
    fn handle(
        &self,
        stream: &mut UnixStream,
        mut handle: impl FnMut(Command) -> Result<Value, String>,
    ) {
        let result = (|| -> Result<Value, String> {
            peer(&stream).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            stream
                .set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5)))
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let bytes = input(stream, Duration::from_secs(5)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            if bytes.len() > INPUT {
                return Err("release control command exceeds 4096 bytes".into());
            }
            let request: Envelope = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            if request.identity != self.identity {
                return Err("release control store identity differs; run releases against the owned deployment".into());
            }
            handle(request.command)
        })();
        let reply = match result {
            Ok(value) => json!({"ok":value}),
            Err(error) => json!({"error":error}),
        };
        let mut bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&reply).unwrap();
        if bytes.len() > OUTPUT {
            bytes=serde_json::to_vec(&json!({"error":"release control reply exceeds its bound; inspect paginated `snapback4 releases <dir>`; an admitted activation/prune may already have committed"})).unwrap();
        }
        // A timeout/lost peer does not cancel or undo admitted work.
        let _ = stream.write_all(&bytes);
    }
    pub(crate) fn run(self, mut handle: impl FnMut(Command) -> Result<Value, String>) {
        while !crate::lifecycle::stopping() {
            match self.accept() {
                Ok(mut stream) => {
                    self.handle(&mut stream, &mut handle);
                }
                Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {
                    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(25))
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    snapback4_core::diagnostic!("release control accept: {e}");
                    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
#[cfg(unix)]
impl Drop for Listener {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if fs::symlink_metadata(&self.path)
            .is_ok_and(|m| m.file_type().is_socket() && (m.dev(), m.ino()) == self.inode)
        {
            let _ = fs::remove_file(&self.path);
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(unix)]
pub(crate) fn request(dir: &Path, command: Command) -> Result<Value, String> {
    let store = dir.join("store.sqlite");
    let unavailable = |reason: String| {
        let owner_path = store.canonicalize().unwrap_or_else(|_| store.clone());
        let detail = if reason.contains("No such file or directory") {
            "this deployment has no release control socket".to_owned()
        } else {
            reason
        };
        format!(
            "{}; release control unavailable: {detail}; stop `snapback4 serve {}`, rerun the exact command, then `snapback4 serve {}`",
            crate::store_owner::busy(&owner_path),
            dir.display(),
            dir.display()
        )
    };
    let path = address(dir, false).map_err(|e| unavailable(e.to_string()))?;
    let before = socket_entry(&path).map_err(|e| unavailable(e.to_string()))?;
    let mut stream = UnixStream::connect(&path).map_err(|e| unavailable(e.to_string()))?;
    peer(&stream).map_err(|e| unavailable(e.to_string()))?;
    let after = socket_entry(&path).map_err(|e| unavailable(e.to_string()))?;
    if (before.dev(), before.ino()) != (after.dev(), after.ino()) {
        return Err(unavailable(
            "release control socket changed before send".into(),
        ));
    }
    stream
        .set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(120)))
        .map_err(|e| unavailable(e.to_string()))?;
    stream
        .set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5)))
        .map_err(|e| unavailable(e.to_string()))?;
    let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&Envelope {
        identity: identity(&store)?,
        command,
    })
    .unwrap();
    if bytes.len() > INPUT {
        return Err("release control command exceeds 4096 bytes".into());
    }
    let ambiguous = |reason: io::Error| {
        format!(
            "release command result is unknown: {reason}; run `snapback4 releases {}` to inspect database authority; the server continues admitted work. Do not automatically deploy another release",
            dir.display()
        )
    };
    stream.write_all(&bytes).map_err(ambiguous)?;
    stream
        .shutdown(std::net::Shutdown::Write)
        .map_err(ambiguous)?;
    let mut reply = Vec::new();
    stream
        .take((OUTPUT + 1) as u64)
        .read_to_end(&mut reply)
        .map_err(ambiguous)?;
    if reply.len() > OUTPUT {
        return Err("release reply too large; inspect releases before retrying".into());
    }
    let value: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&reply).map_err(|e| {
        format!(
            "release result is unknown ({e}); inspect `snapback4 releases {}` before retrying",
            dir.display()
        )
    })?;
    match value.get("ok") {
        Some(value) => Ok(value.clone()),
        None => Err(value["error"]
            .as_str()
            .unwrap_or("release control refused command; inspect releases")
            .into()),
    }
}

#[cfg(not(unix))]
pub(crate) fn request(_: &Path, _: Command) -> Result<Value, String> {
    Err("local release control requires Unix".into())
}

#[cfg(all(test, unix))]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::sync::{
        atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering},
        mpsc,
    };
    static NEXT: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);
    struct Directory(PathBuf);
    impl Directory {
        fn new(long: bool) -> Self {
            let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
                "sb4-roll-control-{}-{}",
                std::process::id(),
                NEXT.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)
            ));
            let root = if long {
                root.join("long-path-component".repeat(6))
            } else {
                root
            };
            snapback4_core::private_fs::directory(&root).unwrap();
            let _store = snapback4_core::Store::open(&root.join("store.sqlite")).unwrap();
            Self(root)
        }
    }
    impl Drop for Directory {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&self.0);
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn socket_permissions_and_entry_types_are_enforced() {
        let dir = Directory::new(false);
        let path = address(&dir.0, true).unwrap();
        fs::write(&path, "not a socket").unwrap();
        assert!(
            Listener::bind(&dir.0, &dir.0.join("store.sqlite"))
                .err()
                .unwrap()
                .contains("0600 socket")
        );
        fs::remove_file(&path).unwrap();
        std::os::unix::fs::symlink("store.sqlite", &path).unwrap();
        assert!(Listener::bind(&dir.0, &dir.0.join("store.sqlite")).is_err());
        fs::remove_file(&path).unwrap();
        let listener = Listener::bind(&dir.0, &dir.0.join("store.sqlite")).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            fs::metadata(&path).unwrap().permissions().mode() & 0o777,
            0o600
        );
        for mode in [0o666, 0o1600] {
            fs::set_permissions(&path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(mode)).unwrap();
            assert!(
                request(
                    &dir.0,
                    Command::Status {
                        after: 0,
                        items_after: None,
                        event: None
                    }
                )
                .unwrap_err()
                .contains("0600 socket")
            );
        }
        drop(listener);
        assert!(!path.exists());
    }
    #[test]
    fn accepted_nonblocking_listener_waits_for_delayed_client_input() {
        let dir = Directory::new(false);
        let listener = Listener::bind(&dir.0, &dir.0.join("store.sqlite")).unwrap();
        let path = listener.path.clone();
        let envelope = Envelope {
            identity: listener.identity.clone(),
            command: Command::Status { after: 0, items_after: None, event: None },
        };
        // Connect before starting accept so the listener stays nonblocking.
        let mut client = UnixStream::connect(&path).unwrap();
        client.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(10))).unwrap();
        client.set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(10))).unwrap();
        let (accepted, waiting) = mpsc::channel();
        let task = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let mut stream = listener.accept().unwrap();
            accepted.send(()).unwrap();
            listener.handle(&mut stream, |command| {
                assert!(matches!(command, Command::Status { after: 0, .. }));
                Ok(json!({"delayed":true}))
            });
        });
        waiting.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10)).unwrap();
        // Without normalization Darwin reads WouldBlock and closes the peer
        // here. Linux accept does not inherit O_NONBLOCK, so it cannot expose
        // the unfixed platform bug with this test.
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));
        client.write_all(&serde_json::to_vec(&envelope).unwrap()).unwrap();
        client.shutdown(std::net::Shutdown::Write).unwrap();
        let mut reply = String::new();
        client.read_to_string(&mut reply).unwrap();
        task.join().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&reply).unwrap(), json!({"ok":{"delayed":true}}));
    }
    #[test]
    fn input_deadline_expires_while_the_peer_keeps_sending() {
        let (mut reader, mut writer) = UnixStream::pair().unwrap();
        let task = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            while writer.write_all(b" ").is_ok() {
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20));
            }
        });
        let started = Instant::now();
        let error = input(&mut reader, Duration::from_millis(300)).unwrap_err();
        assert!(
            matches!(
                error.kind(),
                io::ErrorKind::TimedOut | io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock
            ),
            "{error}"
        );
        assert!(
            started.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(2),
            "input deadline reset on each read"
        );
        drop(reader);
        task.join().unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn runtime_directory_refuses_permissions_symlinks_files_and_wrong_owner() {
        let dir = Directory::new(false);
        let runtime = dir.0.join("runtime");
        private_directory(&runtime, true).unwrap();
        private_directory(&runtime, false).unwrap();
        let m = fs::metadata(&runtime).unwrap();
        assert!(directory_metadata(&m, m.uid().wrapping_add(1)).is_err());
        for mode in [0o755, 0o777, 0o1700] {
            fs::set_permissions(&runtime, fs::Permissions::from_mode(mode)).unwrap();
            assert!(private_directory(&runtime, true).is_err());
            assert!(private_directory(&runtime, false).is_err());
            assert_eq!(fs::metadata(&runtime).unwrap().mode() & 0o7777, mode);
        }
        fs::remove_dir(&runtime).unwrap();
        fs::write(&runtime, "untouched").unwrap();
        assert!(private_directory(&runtime, true).is_err());
        assert_eq!(fs::read(&runtime).unwrap(), b"untouched");
        fs::remove_file(&runtime).unwrap();
        std::os::unix::fs::symlink(&dir.0, &runtime).unwrap();
        assert!(private_directory(&runtime, true).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn stale_socket_is_replaced_but_a_live_listener_is_preserved() {
        let dir = Directory::new(false);
        let store = dir.0.join("store.sqlite");
        let path = address(&dir.0, true).unwrap();
        let stale = UnixListener::bind(&path).unwrap();
        fs::set_permissions(&path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600)).unwrap();
        drop(stale); // Process death leaves the socket entry behind.
        let live = Listener::bind(&dir.0, &store).unwrap();
        let inode = live.inode;
        assert!(
            Listener::bind(&dir.0, &store)
                .err()
                .unwrap()
                .contains("live listener")
        );
        let m = fs::symlink_metadata(&path).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((m.dev(), m.ino()), inode);
        drop(live);
        assert!(!path.exists());
    }

    #[test]
    fn cleanup_preserves_a_replacement_and_canonical_aliases_share_an_address() {
        let dir = Directory::new(false);
        let other = Directory::new(false);
        let store = dir.0.join("store.sqlite");
        let listener = Listener::bind(&dir.0, &store).unwrap();
        let path = listener.path.clone();
        assert_ne!(path, address(&other.0, true).unwrap());
        let alias = dir.0.join("alias");
        std::os::unix::fs::symlink(&dir.0, &alias).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(path, address(&alias, false).unwrap());
        assert!(path.as_os_str().as_bytes().len() < 104);
        fs::remove_file(&path).unwrap();
        fs::write(&path, "replacement").unwrap();
        drop(listener);
        assert_eq!(fs::read(&path).unwrap(), b"replacement");
        fs::remove_file(&path).unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejected_store_identity_does_not_execute_command() {
        let dir = Directory::new(false);
        let listener = Listener::bind(&dir.0, &dir.0.join("store.sqlite")).unwrap();
        listener.listener.set_nonblocking(false).unwrap();
        let task = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let (mut stream, _) = listener.listener.accept().unwrap();
            listener.handle(&mut stream, |_| panic!("wrong identity admitted"));
        });
        let mut stream = UnixStream::connect(address(&dir.0, true).unwrap()).unwrap();
        stream.write_all(br#"{"identity":"wrong","command":{"command":"status","after":0,"items_after":null,"event":null}}"#).unwrap();
        stream.shutdown(std::net::Shutdown::Write).unwrap();
        let mut reply = String::new();
        stream.read_to_string(&mut reply).unwrap();
        assert!(reply.contains("identity differs"));
        task.join().unwrap();
    }
    #[test]
    fn lost_reply_does_not_cancel_admitted_command() {
        let dir = Directory::new(false);
        let listener = Listener::bind(&dir.0, &dir.0.join("store.sqlite")).unwrap();
        listener.listener.set_nonblocking(false).unwrap();
        let (entered, waiting) = mpsc::channel();
        let (resume, resumed) = mpsc::channel();
        let (done, finished) = mpsc::channel();
        let task = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let (mut stream, _) = listener.listener.accept().unwrap();
            listener.handle(&mut stream, |_| {
                entered.send(()).unwrap();
                resumed.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10)).unwrap();
                done.send(()).unwrap();
                Ok(json!({"committed":true}))
            });
        });
        let mut stream = UnixStream::connect(address(&dir.0, true).unwrap()).unwrap();
        let envelope = Envelope {
            identity: identity(&dir.0.join("store.sqlite")).unwrap(),
            command: Command::Prune {
                confirm: true,
                expected_revision: 1,
            },
        };
        stream
            .write_all(&serde_json::to_vec(&envelope).unwrap())
            .unwrap();
        stream.shutdown(std::net::Shutdown::Write).unwrap();
        waiting.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10)).unwrap();
        drop(stream);
        resume.send(()).unwrap();
        finished.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10)).unwrap();
        task.join().unwrap();
    }
    #[test]
    fn long_deployment_path_uses_same_private_socket() {
        let dir = Directory::new(true);
        assert!(dir.0.as_os_str().as_bytes().len() > 108);
        let listener = Listener::bind(&dir.0, &dir.0.join("store.sqlite")).unwrap();
        listener.listener.set_nonblocking(false).unwrap();
        let task = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let (mut stream, _) = listener.listener.accept().unwrap();
            listener.handle(&mut stream, |_| Ok(json!({"release":2})));
        });
        assert_eq!(
            request(
                &dir.0,
                Command::Status {
                    after: 0,
                    items_after: None,
                    event: None
                }
            )
            .unwrap()["release"],
            2
        );
        task.join().unwrap();
        assert!(!address(&dir.0, true).unwrap().exists());
    }
}
