//! Argument-presence decisions select ordinary admitted reads, before planning.
use super::{catalog::{Catalog, TableInfo}, intent, intent_walk as walk};
use crate::{ast::*, diag::{Diagnostic, Site}};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};

pub(super) const PRESENT: &str = "$intentPresent";
pub(super) const SEARCH: &str = "$intentSearch";
type Inputs = BTreeMap<String, bool>; // argument-only binding -> possibly optional

pub(super) fn condition(expr: &Expr) -> Option<(&str, &Expr)> {
    if let Expr::Call { name, args, .. } = expr && matches!(name.as_str(), PRESENT | SEARCH) {
        args.first().map(|arg| (name.as_str(), arg))
    } else { None }
}

// @ref LLP 3000.013#2.1 — presence alternatives share normal planning,
// authorization, admission, meters and the server/device interpreter.
pub(super) fn expand(catalog: &mut Catalog) {
    let mut notes = Vec::new();
    // Keep authored expressions in why/check output before snapshots and
    // alternatives introduce private compiler names at those same sites.
    for doc in &mut catalog.documents {
        walk::document(doc, &mut |value| {
            if let Expr::Read(read) | Expr::Exists { read, .. } = value {
                catalog.read_origins.entry(read.site.to_string()).or_insert_with(|| catalog.source.expression(&Expr::Read(read.clone())));
                catalog.canonical_read_origins.entry(read.site.to_string()).or_insert_with(|| if read.index.is_none() { crate::print::read_expr(read) } else { catalog.source.expression(&Expr::Read(read.clone())) });
            }
        });
    }
    for doc in &mut catalog.documents {
        for program in &mut doc.programs {
            let mut inputs = inputs(&program.args);
            body(&mut program.prelude, &mut inputs, &catalog.functions, &catalog.tables, &mut notes);
            body(&mut program.body, &mut inputs, &catalog.functions, &catalog.tables, &mut notes);
        }
        for function in &mut doc.functions {
            let mut inputs = inputs(&function.args);
            match &mut function.body {
                FunctionBody::Expression(value) => expression(value, &inputs, &catalog.functions, &catalog.tables, &mut notes),
                FunctionBody::Block(stmts) => body(stmts, &mut inputs, &catalog.functions, &catalog.tables, &mut notes),
            }
        }
        for shape in &mut doc.shapes {
            walk::shape(&mut shape.fields, &mut |value| rewrite(value, &Inputs::new(), &catalog.functions, &catalog.tables, &mut notes));
        }
    }
    catalog.planner_notes.extend(notes);
}

fn inputs(args: &[ArgDecl]) -> Inputs { args.iter().map(|arg| (arg.name.clone(), arg.type_.optional)).collect() }

fn input_only(value: &Expr, inputs: &Inputs, functions: &BTreeMap<String, FunctionDecl>) -> bool {
    fn check(value: &Expr, inputs: &Inputs, functions: &BTreeMap<String, FunctionDecl>, stack: &mut BTreeSet<String>) -> bool {
        match value {
            Expr::Name { name, .. } => inputs.contains_key(name),
            Expr::Literal { .. } => true,
            Expr::Unary { value, .. } | Expr::Assert { value, .. } => check(value, inputs, functions, stack),
            Expr::Binary { left, right, .. } => check(left, inputs, functions, stack) && check(right, inputs, functions, stack),
            Expr::If { condition, then, otherwise, .. } => [condition, then, otherwise].iter().all(|value| check(value, inputs, functions, stack)),
            Expr::Array { items, .. } => items.iter().all(|value| check(value, inputs, functions, stack)),
            Expr::Call { name, args, .. } => {
                if !args.iter().all(|value| check(value, inputs, functions, stack)) { return false; }
                if let Some(function) = functions.get(name) {
                    if !stack.insert(name.clone()) { return false; }
                    let mut local = self::inputs(&function.args);
                    let result = match &function.body {
                        FunctionBody::Expression(value) => check(value, &local, functions, stack),
                        FunctionBody::Block(body) => pure_body(body, &mut local, functions, stack),
                    };
                    stack.remove(name); result
                } else { ["lower", "trim", "count", "first", "last", "at", "slice", "min", "max", "join", "tokens", "range", "sha256", "share"].contains(&name.as_str()) }
            }
            _ => false,
        }
    }
    fn pure_body(body: &[Stmt], inputs: &mut Inputs, functions: &BTreeMap<String, FunctionDecl>, stack: &mut BTreeSet<String>) -> bool {
        body.iter().all(|stmt| match stmt {
            Stmt::Bind { names, value, .. } => {
                if !check(value, inputs, functions, stack) { return false; }
                for name in names { inputs.insert(name.clone(), true); } true
            }
            Stmt::Return { value, .. } | Stmt::Expr { value, .. } => check(value, inputs, functions, stack),
            Stmt::Require { condition, .. } => check(condition, inputs, functions, stack),
            Stmt::If { condition, then_body, else_body, .. } => check(condition, inputs, functions, stack)
                && pure_body(then_body, &mut inputs.clone(), functions, stack) && pure_body(else_body, &mut inputs.clone(), functions, stack),
            Stmt::For { name, domain, body, .. } => {
                if !check(domain, inputs, functions, stack) { return false; }
                let mut local = inputs.clone();
                local.insert(name.clone(), true);
                pure_body(body, &mut local, functions, stack)
            }
            _ => false,
        })
    }
    check(value, inputs, functions, &mut BTreeSet::new())
}

fn possibly_optional(value: &Expr, inputs: &Inputs) -> bool {
    match value {
        Expr::Name { name, .. } => inputs.get(name).copied().unwrap_or(true),
        Expr::Literal { value, .. } => matches!(value, Literal::Null),
        Expr::Assert { .. } | Expr::Unary { .. } => false,
        Expr::Binary { op, right, .. } => op == "??" && possibly_optional(right, inputs),
        Expr::If { then, otherwise, .. } => possibly_optional(then, inputs) || possibly_optional(otherwise, inputs),
        Expr::Array { .. } => false,
        _ => true,
    }
}

fn body(stmts: &mut [Stmt], inputs: &mut Inputs, functions: &BTreeMap<String, FunctionDecl>, tables: &BTreeMap<String, TableInfo>, notes: &mut Vec<Diagnostic>) {
    for stmt in stmts {
        match stmt {
            Stmt::Bind { names, value, .. } => {
                let only = input_only(value, inputs, functions);
                let optional = possibly_optional(value, inputs);
                expression(value, inputs, functions, tables, notes);
                for name in names { if only { inputs.insert(name.clone(), optional); } else { inputs.remove(name); } }
            }
            Stmt::If { condition, then_body, else_body, .. } => {
                expression(condition, inputs, functions, tables, notes);
                let (mut yes, mut no) = (inputs.clone(), inputs.clone());
                body(then_body, &mut yes, functions, tables, notes); body(else_body, &mut no, functions, tables, notes);
                inputs.retain(|name, optional| {
                    if let (Some(a), Some(b)) = (yes.get(name), no.get(name)) { *optional = *a || *b; true } else { false }
                });
            }
            Stmt::As { principal, body: stmts, .. } => {
                expression(principal, inputs, functions, tables, notes);
                body(stmts, inputs, functions, tables, notes);
            }
            Stmt::For { name, domain, body: stmts, .. } => {
                expression(domain, inputs, functions, tables, notes);
                let mut changed = BTreeSet::new();
                assignments(stmts, &mut changed);
                for name in changed { inputs.remove(&name); }
                let mut local = inputs.clone(); local.remove(name);
                body(stmts, &mut local, functions, tables, notes);
            }
            other => walk::statements(std::slice::from_mut(other), &mut |value| rewrite(value, inputs, functions, tables, notes)),
        }
    }
}
fn assignments(stmts: &[Stmt], names: &mut BTreeSet<String>) {
    for stmt in stmts { match stmt {
        Stmt::Bind { names: bound, .. } => names.extend(bound.iter().cloned()),
        Stmt::If { then_body, else_body, .. } => { assignments(then_body, names); assignments(else_body, names); }
        Stmt::As { body, .. } | Stmt::For { body, .. } => assignments(body, names), _ => {},
    } }
}
fn expression(value: &mut Expr, inputs: &Inputs, functions: &BTreeMap<String, FunctionDecl>, tables: &BTreeMap<String, TableInfo>, notes: &mut Vec<Diagnostic>) {
    walk::expression(value, &mut |value| rewrite(value, inputs, functions, tables, notes));
}
// Snapshot a needle once: choosing its presence must not rerun a helper's
// reads or mutation effects when the selected words scan evaluates matching.
fn search_condition(needle: Expr, site: &Site) -> (Expr, Expr) {
    let name = format!("$intentNeedle{}", snapback4_core::value::digest(&site.to_string()));
    let binding = Expr::Name { name, site: site.clone() };
    (Expr::Call { name: SEARCH.into(), args: vec![needle, binding.clone()], site: site.clone() }, binding)
}

fn rewrite(value: &mut Expr, inputs: &Inputs, functions: &BTreeMap<String, FunctionDecl>, tables: &BTreeMap<String, TableInfo>, notes: &mut Vec<Diagnostic>) {
    match value {
        Expr::Merge(merge) if merge.matching.is_some() => {
            if let Some(index) = tables.get(&merge.table).and_then(|table| table.indexes.iter().find(|index| index.name == merge.index))
                && let Some((position, _)) = &index.words {
                let mut browse = merge.clone();
                browse.matching = None;
                for lane in &mut browse.lanes {
                    lane.planned = Some(Box::new(ReadExpr { cursor_prefix: None,
                        table: merge.table.clone(), index: Some(merge.index.clone()), computed: index.computed.clone(),
                        keys: lane.prefix.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, value)| KeyPart {
                            column: lane.columns.as_ref().and_then(|names| names.get(i).cloned().flatten()).or_else(|| index.columns.get(i).cloned()),
                            value: value.clone(), site: value.site().clone(),
                        }).collect(),
                        order_keys: index.columns[*position..].to_vec(), seeks: Vec::new(), matching: None,
                        filter: merge.filter.clone(), range: Some(RangeSpec { order: merge.order, take: merge.take, cursor: None, site: lane.site.clone() }), site: lane.site.clone(),
                    }));
                    browse_leaf(lane.planned.as_mut().unwrap(), tables);
                }
                let (condition, needle) = search_condition(*merge.matching.clone().unwrap(), &merge.site);
                let mut matching = merge.clone(); matching.matching = Some(Box::new(needle));
                *value = Expr::If { condition: Box::new(condition),
                    then: Box::new(Expr::Merge(matching)), otherwise: Box::new(Expr::Merge(browse)), site: merge.site.clone() };
            }
        }
        Expr::Read(_) | Expr::Exists { .. } => {
            let exists = matches!(value, Expr::Exists { .. });
            let read = match value { Expr::Read(read) | Expr::Exists { read, .. } => read, _ => unreachable!() };
            if let Some(planned) = variants(read, exists, inputs, tables, functions, notes) { *value = planned; }
        }
        Expr::Call { name, args, site } if super::intent_aggregates::is_consumer(name, args, tables) && !functions.contains_key(name)
            && args.first().is_some_and(|arg| matches!(arg, Expr::If { condition: test, .. } if condition(test).is_some())) => {
                *value = lift(name, args, site, tables, &inputs.iter().filter(|(_, optional)| !**optional).map(|(name, _)| name.clone()).collect());
            }
        _ => {},
    }
}
fn lift(name: &str, args: &[Expr], site: &Site, tables: &BTreeMap<String, TableInfo>, required: &BTreeSet<String>) -> Expr {
    if let Expr::If { then, condition, otherwise, site: branch } = &args[0] {
        let mut yes = args.to_vec(); yes[0] = *then.clone();
        let mut no = args.to_vec(); no[0] = *otherwise.clone();
        let mut present = required.clone();
        if let Some((PRESENT, Expr::Name { name, .. })) = self::condition(condition) { present.insert(name.clone()); }
        Expr::If { then: Box::new(lift(name, &yes, site, tables, &present)), condition: condition.clone(), otherwise: Box::new(lift(name, &no, site, tables, required)), site: branch.clone() }
    } else {
        let mut args = args.to_vec();
        super::intent_aggregates::choose_consumer(name, &mut args, tables, required);
        Expr::Call { name: name.into(), args, site: site.clone() }
    }
}

fn optional<'a>(predicate: &'a Expr, inputs: &Inputs, functions: &BTreeMap<String, FunctionDecl>) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a Expr)> {
    let Expr::Binary { op, left, right, .. } = predicate else { return None; };
    if op != "or" { return None; }
    for (guard, value) in [(left, right), (right, left)] {
        let Expr::Binary { op, left, right, .. } = guard.as_ref() else { continue; };
        if op != "=" { continue; }
        let name = match (left.as_ref(), right.as_ref()) {
            (Expr::Name { name, .. }, Expr::Literal { value: Literal::Null, .. }) |
            (Expr::Literal { value: Literal::Null, .. }, Expr::Name { name, .. }) => name,
            _ => continue,
        };
        if inputs.get(name) != Some(&true) { continue; }
        let Expr::Binary { op, left, right, .. } = value.as_ref() else { continue; };
        if !matches!(op.as_str(), "=" | "in" | "<" | "<=" | ">" | ">=") { continue; }
        let endpoint = if intent::column(left).is_some() { right } else if op != "in" && intent::column(right).is_some() { left } else { continue; };
        if !input_only(endpoint, inputs, functions) { continue; }
        let required = inputs.iter().filter(|(input, optional)| !**optional || *input == name).map(|(input, _)| input.clone()).collect();
        if !super::intent_aggregates::safe_endpoint(endpoint, &required) { continue; }
        let mut used = BTreeSet::new();
        walk::expression(&mut *endpoint.clone(), &mut |e| { if let Expr::Name { name, .. } = e { used.insert(name.clone()); } });
        if !used.contains(name) || used.iter().any(|other| other != name && inputs.get(other) == Some(&true)) { continue; }
        return Some((name, value));
    }
    None
}

fn variants(read: &ReadExpr, exists: bool, inputs: &Inputs, tables: &BTreeMap<String, TableInfo>, functions: &BTreeMap<String, FunctionDecl>, notes: &mut Vec<Diagnostic>) -> Option<Expr> {
    let mut parts = Vec::new();
    if let Some(filter) = &read.filter { intent::split(*filter.clone(), &mut parts); }
    let candidates: Vec<_> = parts.iter().enumerate().filter_map(|(i, value)| optional(value, inputs, functions).map(|(name, predicate)| (i, name.to_owned(), predicate.clone()))).collect();
    let mut names = Vec::new();
    for (_, name, _) in &candidates { if !names.contains(name) { names.push(name.clone()); } }
    if names.len() > 3 {
        let extra = names[3..].join(", ");
        notes.push(Diagnostic::new(&read.site, "N_OPTIONAL_FILTER_LIMIT", format!("optional filters {extra} stay residual: at most three inputs receive presence variants"),
            format!("keep these metered residual filters, or branch on {extra} in separate queries to plan their pins")).guide("reads"));
        names.truncate(3);
    }
    let search = read.matching.clone();
    if names.is_empty() && search.is_none() { return None; }
    let search = search.map(|needle| search_condition(*needle, &read.site));
    let mut read = read.clone();
    read.matching = search.as_ref().map(|(_, needle)| Box::new(needle.clone()));
    let tests: Vec<_> = names.iter().map(|name| Expr::Call { name: PRESENT.into(), args: vec![Expr::Name { name: name.clone(), site: read.site.clone() }], site: read.site.clone() })
        .chain(search.iter().map(|(condition, _)| condition.clone())).collect();
    fn build(read: &ReadExpr, exists: bool, parts: &[Expr], candidates: &[(usize, String, Expr)], names: &[String], tests: &[Expr], bits: &mut Vec<bool>, tables: &BTreeMap<String, TableInfo>, required: &BTreeSet<String>) -> Expr {
        if bits.len() < tests.len() {
            let test = tests[bits.len()].clone();
            bits.push(true); let yes = build(read, exists, parts, candidates, names, tests, bits, tables, required);
            *bits.last_mut().unwrap() = false; let no = build(read, exists, parts, candidates, names, tests, bits, tables, required);
            bits.pop();
            return Expr::If { condition: Box::new(test), then: Box::new(yes), otherwise: Box::new(no), site: read.site.clone() };
        }
        let mut read = read.clone();
        read.filter = intent::conjunction(parts.iter().enumerate().filter_map(|(i, original)| {
            if let Some((_, name, predicate)) = candidates.iter().find(|(at, name, _)| *at == i && names.contains(name)) {
                bits[names.iter().position(|n| n == name).unwrap()].then(|| predicate.clone())
            } else { Some(original.clone()) }
        }).collect());
        if read.matching.is_some() && !bits[names.len()] {
            browse_leaf(&mut read, tables);
        }
        if exists {
            let mut required = required.clone();
            required.extend(names.iter().zip(bits).filter(|(_, present)| **present).map(|(name, _)| name.clone()));
            super::intent_aggregates::choose(&mut read, tables, &required);
            Expr::Exists { site: read.site.clone(), read }
        } else { Expr::Read(read) }
    }
    let required = inputs.iter().filter(|(_, optional)| !**optional).map(|(name, _)| name.clone()).collect();
    Some(build(&read, exists, &parts, &candidates, &names, &tests, &mut Vec::new(), tables, &required))
}

// Normalize this generated read only. Its predicates, needle and key values
// may contain unrelated point reads whose columns and order must not change.
// @ref LLP 3000.013#2.1 — an explicit words order disambiguates its browse alternative only.
fn browse_leaf(read: &mut ReadExpr, tables: &BTreeMap<String, TableInfo>) {
    read.matching = None;
    let authored = read.index.take().and_then(|name| tables.get(&read.table)?.indexes.iter().find(|index| index.name == name));
    let Some(index) = authored else { return; };
    // The named unique search was normalized before variants. Planning checks
    // compatibility after this branch's predicate equalities have been pinned.
    if index.unique && index.is_plain() && !read.order_keys.is_empty() {
        read.index = Some(index.name.clone());
        return;
    }
    let Some((position, _)) = &index.words else { return; };
    for (key, column) in read.keys.iter_mut().zip(&index.columns) { key.column.get_or_insert_with(|| column.clone()); }
    if read.order_keys.is_empty() { read.order_keys = index.columns[*position..].to_vec(); }
    read.computed = index.computed.clone();
    // The authored words index already resolved the intended ordering. Its
    // generated browse alternative deterministically reuses an equivalent
    // plain index. Only a total unique key can leave id implicit in its cursor.
    let table = &tables[&read.table];
    let ordered = |index: &IndexDecl| {
        let mut columns = index.columns.clone();
        if columns.last().map(String::as_str) != Some("id") { columns.push("id".into()); }
        columns
    };
    let computed = super::intent::computed_descriptor(table, &index.computed);
    read.index = table.indexes.iter().filter(|candidate| candidate.words.is_none() && table.total_cursor(candidate)
        && ordered(candidate) == ordered(index)
        && super::intent::computed_descriptor(table, &candidate.computed) == computed)
        .min_by_key(|candidate| &candidate.name).map(|candidate| candidate.name.clone());
}
//! Receipt-template hygiene and author-site custody, before ordinary planning.
// @ref LLP 3000.022#14.1 — generated calls cannot capture application declarations.
use crate::{ast::*, diag::Site};

pub(super) fn expression_keyword(name: &str) -> bool {
    matches!(
        name,
        "viewer"
            | "now"
            | "commit"
            | "new"
            | "null"
            | "true"
            | "false"
            | "not"
            | "exists"
            | "created"
            | "walk"
            | "insert"
            | "update"
            | "upsert"
            | "delete"
            | "merge"
            | "device"
            | "oblivious"
            | "where"
            | "after"
            | "if"
            | "else"
            | "and"
            | "or"
    ) || name.contains('-')
}

pub(super) fn receipts(doc: &mut Document, clause: &ReceiptsDecl) {
    let fold = format!("$receipt:{}:fold", clause.name);
    doc.functions.last_mut().expect("receipt fold").name = fold.clone();
    let mut visit = |value: &mut Expr| {
        if let Expr::Call { name, .. } = value {
            *name = match name.as_str() {
                "receiptBuiltinSettled" => "$builtin:receiptSettled".into(),
                "receiptBuiltinFirst" => "$builtin:first".into(),
                "receiptBuiltinMax" => "$builtin:max".into(),
                "receiptBuiltinCount" => "$builtin:count".into(),
                "receiptBuiltinRange" => "$builtin:range".into(),
                "receiptPrivateFold" => fold.clone(),
                _ => panic!("unclassified receipt-template call: {name}"),
            };
        }
        if let Expr::Name { name, .. } = value {
            if name == "viewer" {
                *name = "$input:viewer".into();
            }
        }
        expression_site(value, &clause.site);
    };
    super::intent_walk::document(doc, &mut visit);
    for function in &mut doc.functions {
        function.site = clause.site.clone();
        for arg in &mut function.args {
            arg.site = clause.site.clone();
        }
        if let FunctionBody::Block(body) = &mut function.body {
            statement_sites(body, &clause.site);
        }
    }
    for program in &mut doc.programs {
        program.site = clause.site.clone();
        for arg in &mut program.args {
            arg.site = clause.site.clone();
        }
        if let Some(delivery) = &mut program.delivery {
            delivery.site = clause.site.clone();
        }
        statement_sites(&mut program.prelude, &clause.site);
        statement_sites(&mut program.body, &clause.site);
    }
    for table in &mut doc.tables {
        table.site = clause.site.clone();
        for column in &mut table.columns {
            column.site = clause.site.clone();
        }
        for index in &mut table.indexes {
            index.site = clause.site.clone();
        }
        for cap in &mut table.caps {
            cap.site = clause.site.clone();
        }
        if let Some(sync) = &mut table.sync {
            sync.site = clause.site.clone();
        }
        for rule in &mut table.rules {
            rule.site = clause.site.clone();
            super::intent_walk::expression(&mut rule.value, &mut |e| {
                expression_site(e, &clause.site)
            });
        }
    }
    doc.source = Default::default();
}

fn statement_sites(body: &mut [Stmt], target: &Site) {
    for statement in body {
        let site = match statement {
            Stmt::If {
                then_body,
                else_body,
                site,
                ..
            } => {
                statement_sites(then_body, target);
                statement_sites(else_body, target);
                site
            }
            Stmt::As { body, site, .. } | Stmt::For { body, site, .. } => {
                statement_sites(body, target);
                site
            }
            Stmt::Bind { site, .. }
            | Stmt::Expr { site, .. }
            | Stmt::Require { site, .. }
            | Stmt::Return { site, .. }
            | Stmt::Emit { site, .. }
            | Stmt::Break { site }
            | Stmt::Continue { site } => site,
        };
        *site = target.clone();
    }
}

fn expression_site(value: &mut Expr, target: &Site) {
    let site = match value {
        Expr::Read(read) => {
            read_site(read, target);
            &mut read.site
        }
        Expr::Exists { read, site } | Expr::Created { read, site } => {
            read_site(read, target);
            site
        }
        Expr::Write {
            keys, fields, site, ..
        } => {
            for key in keys {
                key.site = target.clone();
            }
            for field in fields {
                field.site = target.clone();
            }
            site
        }
        Expr::Object { fields, site } => {
            for field in fields {
                field.site = target.clone();
            }
            site
        }
        Expr::Shape { fields, site, .. } => {
            for field in fields {
                let (ShapeField::Bare { site, .. }
                | ShapeField::Field { site, .. }
                | ShapeField::Spread { site }
                | ShapeField::NamedSpread { site, .. }) = field;
                *site = target.clone();
            }
            site
        }
        Expr::Merge(_) => unreachable!("receipt template has no merge"),
        Expr::Name { site, .. }
        | Expr::Focal { site }
        | Expr::Literal { site, .. }
        | Expr::Array { site, .. }
        | Expr::Unary { site, .. }
        | Expr::Binary { site, .. }
        | Expr::Member { site, .. }
        | Expr::Call { site, .. }
        | Expr::Assert { site, .. }
        | Expr::ShapeUse { site, .. }
        | Expr::Walk { site, .. }
        | Expr::If { site, .. } => site,
    };
    *site = target.clone();
}
fn read_site(read: &mut ReadExpr, target: &Site) {
    read.site = target.clone();
    for key in &mut read.keys {
        key.site = target.clone();
    }
    for seek in &mut read.seeks {
        seek.site = target.clone();
    }
    if let Some(range) = &mut read.range {
        range.site = target.clone();
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn all_receipt_expression_sites_belong_to_the_author_clause() {
        let source = include_str!("../../../snapback4/src/verbs/init/social/schema.q");
        let (doc, errors) = crate::parse_document("schema.q", source);
        assert!(errors.is_empty());
        let clause = doc.tables.iter().find_map(|t| t.receipts.clone()).unwrap();
        let mut docs = vec![doc];
        let mut errors = Vec::new();
        super::super::receipts::expand(&mut docs, &mut errors);
        assert!(errors.is_empty(), "{errors:?}");
        let doc = &mut docs[0];
        doc.programs.retain(|p| clause.operations.contains(&p.name));
        doc.functions
            .retain(|f| f.name == clause.operations[0] || f.name.starts_with("$receipt:"));
        let mut count = 0;
        super::super::intent_walk::document(doc, &mut |e| {
            assert_eq!(e.site(), &clause.site, "{e:?}");
            if let Expr::Read(read) | Expr::Exists { read, .. } = e {
                assert_eq!(read.site, clause.site);
                for key in &read.keys {
                    assert_eq!(key.site, clause.site);
                }
                for seek in &read.seeks {
                    assert_eq!(seek.site, clause.site);
                }
            }
            count += 1;
        });
        assert!(count > 300, "visited {count} expressions");
    }
}
//! N_PATCH_CLEARS: an omitted optional argument is null, the same as an
//! explicit null (no test tells them apart), so an edit mutation that patches
//! `{ title, body }` with `body: text ?` clears `body` whenever a client sends
//! only the title (wave 7 lanes 047 090, both "silent data loss"). The note
//! names the patch when the argument goes straight into a nullable column,
//! beside at least one other argument-supplied field (an edit form, not a
//! one-field setter whose null means "clear", nor one stamped `editedAt: now`), and nothing in the mutation tests the argument. An
//! `upsert` is not named: it replaces the caller's record (a vote and its
//! optional note), and its insert arm writes the same null.
// @ref LLP 3000.036#17.9 — omitted means null; the note points at `x ?? row.c` and a clear flag.
use super::catalog::Catalog;
use crate::{ast::*, diag::Diagnostic};

pub(super) fn notes(catalog: &Catalog) -> Vec<Diagnostic> {
    let mut notes = Vec::new();
    for program in catalog.documents.iter().flat_map(|doc| &doc.programs).filter(|p| p.kind == ProgramKind::Mutation && !p.native) {
        let optional: Vec<&str> = program.args.iter().filter(|arg| arg.type_.optional && !matches!(arg.type_.kind, TypeKind::Cursor)).map(|arg| arg.name.as_str()).collect();
        if optional.is_empty() { continue; }
        let mut tested = Vec::new();
        conditions(&program.prelude, &mut tested);
        conditions(&program.body, &mut tested);
        let rows = bindings(&program.body);
        let mut writes = Vec::new();
        let mut body = program.prelude.clone();
        body.extend(program.body.iter().cloned());
        super::intent_walk::statements(&mut body, &mut |expr: &mut Expr| {
            if let Expr::Write { op: op @ WriteOp::Update, table, keys, fields, site, .. } = expr { writes.push((*op, table.clone(), keys.clone(), fields.clone(), site.clone())); }
        });
        for (op, table, keys, fields, site) in writes {
            let Some(info) = catalog.tables.get(&table) else { continue };
            // An edit form: at least two fields the client supplies (bare arguments), not a setter plus a stamp (`editedAt: now`).
            let supplied = fields.iter().filter(|f| match &f.value { None => program.args.iter().any(|a| a.name == f.name), Some(Expr::Name { name, .. }) => program.args.iter().any(|a| &a.name == name), _ => false }).count();
            if fields.iter().any(|f| f.spread) || supplied < 2 { continue; }
            let cleared: Vec<(&str, &str)> = fields.iter().filter_map(|field| {
                let arg = match &field.value { None => field.name.as_str(), Some(Expr::Name { name, .. }) => name.as_str(), _ => return None };
                (optional.contains(&arg) && info.columns.get(&field.name).is_some_and(|ty| ty.optional) && !tested.iter().any(|c| mentions(c, arg)))
                    .then_some((field.name.as_str(), arg))
            }).collect();
            let Some((column, arg)) = cleared.first().copied() else { continue };
            let key = keys.iter().map(|k| match &k.column { Some(c) => format!("{c} = {}", crate::print::expression(&k.value)), None => crate::print::expression(&k.value) }).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ");
            let row = rows.iter().find(|(_, read)| read == &format!("{table}[{key}]")).map(|(name, _)| name.clone());
            let (bind, row) = match row { Some(row) => (String::new(), row), None => (format!("bind `row = {table}[{key}] ! else NOT_FOUND` before it, then "), "row".to_owned()) };
            let all = cleared.iter().map(|(c, a)| if c == a { format!("`{c}`") } else { format!("`{c}` (from `{a}`)") }).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ");
            notes.push(Diagnostic::new(&site, "N_PATCH_CLEARS",
                format!("mutation {}: `{} {table}[{key}]` writes {all} from optional arguments, and an omitted argument is null, the same as an explicit null: a client that sends only the other fields clears `{column}`{}", program.name, op.word(), if cleared.len() > 1 { " (and each other column named)" } else { "" }),
                format!("to keep the stored value when `{arg}` is omitted, {bind}write `{column}: {arg} ?? {row}.{column}`; if clearing is meant too, add `clear: bool ?` and write `{column}: null if clear = true else {arg} ?? {row}.{column}` (guide writes, Details); if a null `{arg}` always means \"clear\", nothing changes")).guide("writes"));
        }
    }
    notes
}

fn conditions(body: &[Stmt], out: &mut Vec<Expr>) {
    for statement in body {
        match statement {
            Stmt::Require { condition, .. } => out.push(condition.clone()),
            Stmt::If { condition, then_body, else_body, .. } => { out.push(condition.clone()); conditions(then_body, out); conditions(else_body, out); }
            Stmt::For { body, .. } | Stmt::As { body, .. } => conditions(body, out),
            _ => {}
        }
    }
}

/// `name = t[key]` (with or without `!`) at the top of the body, as `(name, "t[key]")`.
fn bindings(body: &[Stmt]) -> Vec<(String, String)> {
    body.iter().filter_map(|statement| {
        let Stmt::Bind { names, value, .. } = statement else { return None };
        let [name] = names.as_slice() else { return None };
        let read = match value { Expr::Assert { value, .. } => value.as_ref(), other => other };
        let Expr::Read(read) = read else { return None };
        let key = read.keys.iter().map(|k| match &k.column { Some(c) => format!("{c} = {}", crate::print::expression(&k.value)), None => crate::print::expression(&k.value) }).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ");
        Some((name.clone(), format!("{}[{key}]", read.table)))
    }).collect()
}

fn mentions(expr: &Expr, name: &str) -> bool {
    let mut found = false;
    let mut copy = expr.clone();
    super::intent_walk::expression(&mut copy, &mut |e: &mut Expr| { if matches!(e, Expr::Name { name: n, .. } if n == name) { found = true; } });
    found
}

//! Receipt-template hygiene and author-site custody, before ordinary planning.
// @ref LLP 3000.022#14.1 — generated calls cannot capture application declarations.
use crate::{ast::*, diag::Site};

pub(super) fn expression_keyword(name: &str) -> bool {
    matches!(
        name,
        "viewer"
            | "now"
            | "commit"
            | "new"
            | "null"
            | "true"
            | "false"
            | "not"
            | "exists"
            | "created"
            | "walk"
            | "insert"
            | "update"
            | "upsert"
            | "delete"
            | "merge"
            | "device"
            | "oblivious"
            | "where"
            | "after"
            | "if"
            | "else"
            | "and"
            | "or"
    ) || name.contains('-')
}

pub(super) fn receipts(doc: &mut Document, clause: &ReceiptsDecl) {
    let fold = format!("$receipt:{}:fold", clause.name);
    doc.functions.last_mut().expect("receipt fold").name = fold.clone();
    let mut visit = |value: &mut Expr| {
        if let Expr::Call { name, .. } = value {
            *name = match name.as_str() {
                "receiptBuiltinSettled" => "$builtin:receiptSettled".into(),
                "receiptBuiltinFirst" => "$builtin:first".into(),
                "receiptBuiltinMax" => "$builtin:max".into(),
                "receiptBuiltinCount" => "$builtin:count".into(),
                "receiptBuiltinRange" => "$builtin:range".into(),
                "receiptPrivateFold" => fold.clone(),
                _ => panic!("unclassified receipt-template call: {name}"),
            };
        }
        if let Expr::Name { name, .. } = value {
            if name == "viewer" {
                *name = "$input:viewer".into();
            }
        }
        expression_site(value, &clause.site);
    };
    super::intent_walk::document(doc, &mut visit);
    for function in &mut doc.functions {
        function.site = clause.site.clone();
        for arg in &mut function.args {
            arg.site = clause.site.clone();
        }
        if let FunctionBody::Block(body) = &mut function.body {
            statement_sites(body, &clause.site);
        }
    }
    for program in &mut doc.programs {
        program.site = clause.site.clone();
        for arg in &mut program.args {
            arg.site = clause.site.clone();
        }
        if let Some(delivery) = &mut program.delivery {
            delivery.site = clause.site.clone();
        }
        statement_sites(&mut program.prelude, &clause.site);
        statement_sites(&mut program.body, &clause.site);
    }
    for table in &mut doc.tables {
        table.site = clause.site.clone();
        for column in &mut table.columns {
            column.site = clause.site.clone();
        }
        for index in &mut table.indexes {
            index.site = clause.site.clone();
        }
        for cap in &mut table.caps {
            cap.site = clause.site.clone();
        }
        if let Some(sync) = &mut table.sync {
            sync.site = clause.site.clone();
        }
        for rule in &mut table.rules {
            rule.site = clause.site.clone();
            super::intent_walk::expression(&mut rule.value, &mut |e| {
                expression_site(e, &clause.site)
            });
        }
    }
    doc.source = Default::default();
}

fn statement_sites(body: &mut [Stmt], target: &Site) {
    for statement in body {
        let site = match statement {
            Stmt::If {
                then_body,
                else_body,
                site,
                ..
            } => {
                statement_sites(then_body, target);
                statement_sites(else_body, target);
                site
            }
            Stmt::As { body, site, .. } | Stmt::For { body, site, .. } => {
                statement_sites(body, target);
                site
            }
            Stmt::Bind { site, .. }
            | Stmt::Expr { site, .. }
            | Stmt::Require { site, .. }
            | Stmt::Return { site, .. }
            | Stmt::Emit { site, .. }
            | Stmt::Break { site }
            | Stmt::Continue { site } => site,
        };
        *site = target.clone();
    }
}

fn expression_site(value: &mut Expr, target: &Site) {
    let site = match value {
        Expr::Read(read) => {
            read_site(read, target);
            &mut read.site
        }
        Expr::Exists { read, site } | Expr::Created { read, site } => {
            read_site(read, target);
            site
        }
        Expr::Write {
            keys, fields, site, ..
        } => {
            for key in keys {
                key.site = target.clone();
            }
            for field in fields {
                field.site = target.clone();
            }
            site
        }
        Expr::Object { fields, site } => {
            for field in fields {
                field.site = target.clone();
            }
            site
        }
        Expr::Shape { fields, site, .. } => {
            for field in fields {
                let (ShapeField::Bare { site, .. }
                | ShapeField::Field { site, .. }
                | ShapeField::Spread { site }
                | ShapeField::NamedSpread { site, .. }) = field;
                *site = target.clone();
            }
            site
        }
        Expr::Merge(_) => unreachable!("receipt template has no merge"),
        Expr::Name { site, .. }
        | Expr::Focal { site }
        | Expr::Literal { site, .. }
        | Expr::Array { site, .. }
        | Expr::Unary { site, .. }
        | Expr::Binary { site, .. }
        | Expr::Member { site, .. }
        | Expr::Call { site, .. }
        | Expr::Assert { site, .. }
        | Expr::ShapeUse { site, .. }
        | Expr::Walk { site, .. }
        | Expr::If { site, .. } => site,
    };
    *site = target.clone();
}
fn read_site(read: &mut ReadExpr, target: &Site) {
    read.site = target.clone();
    for key in &mut read.keys {
        key.site = target.clone();
    }
    for seek in &mut read.seeks {
        seek.site = target.clone();
    }
    if let Some(range) = &mut read.range {
        range.site = target.clone();
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn all_receipt_expression_sites_belong_to_the_author_clause() {
        let source = include_str!("../../../snapback4/src/verbs/init/social/schema.q");
        let (doc, errors) = crate::parse_document("schema.q", source);
        assert!(errors.is_empty());
        let clause = doc.tables.iter().find_map(|t| t.receipts.clone()).unwrap();
        let mut docs = vec![doc];
        let mut errors = Vec::new();
        super::super::receipts::expand(&mut docs, &mut errors);
        assert!(errors.is_empty(), "{errors:?}");
        let doc = &mut docs[0];
        doc.programs.retain(|p| clause.operations.contains(&p.name));
        doc.functions
            .retain(|f| f.name == clause.operations[0] || f.name.starts_with("$receipt:"));
        let mut count = 0;
        super::super::intent_walk::document(doc, &mut |e| {
            assert_eq!(e.site(), &clause.site, "{e:?}");
            if let Expr::Read(read) | Expr::Exists { read, .. } = e {
                assert_eq!(read.site, clause.site);
                for key in &read.keys {
                    assert_eq!(key.site, clause.site);
                }
                for seek in &read.seeks {
                    assert_eq!(seek.site, clause.site);
                }
            }
            count += 1;
        });
        assert!(count > 300, "visited {count} expressions");
    }
}

#[cfg(not(all(target_arch = "wasm32", feature = "web", not(feature = "sqlite"))))]
pub fn validate_inputs(schema: &Schema, program: &Program, inputs: &mut BTreeMap<String, Value>) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    super::admission::check(schema, program)?;
    validate_arguments(schema, program, inputs)
}

// @ref LLP 3000.002#proposed-device-representation-and-codec-redesign — the web predicts a server-admitted backend; the server and native hosts still check every call.
pub(super) fn validate_device_inputs(schema: &Schema, program: &Program, inputs: &mut BTreeMap<String, Value>) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    #[cfg(not(any(all(target_arch = "wasm32", feature = "web", not(feature = "sqlite")), feature = "web-device-check")))]
    super::admission::check(schema, program)?;
    validate_arguments(schema, program, inputs)
}

fn validate_arguments(schema: &Schema, program: &Program, inputs: &mut BTreeMap<String, Value>) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    for (name, kind) in &program.args {
        if !inputs.contains_key(name) && (kind.is_optional() || matches!(kind, ArgType::Cursor)) {
            inputs.insert(name.clone(), Value::Null);
        }
        let value = inputs.get(name).ok_or_else(|| RuntimeError::Input(format!("missing argument {name}")))?;
        validate_arg(schema, kind, value, name)?;
    }
    if let Some(extra) = inputs.keys().find(|name| !program.args.contains_key(*name)) {
        return Err(RuntimeError::Input(format!("{} takes no argument {extra}", program.name)));
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub fn validate_arg(schema: &Schema, kind: &ArgType, value: &Value, label: &str) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    if !kind.bounds_valid() {
        return Err(RuntimeError::Input(format!("{label} has a minimum greater than its maximum")));
    }
    crate::value::validate_identities(value)?;
    if contains_system_principal(value) {
        return Err(RuntimeError::Input(format!("{label} cannot carry the reserved system principal")));
    }
    match kind {
        ArgType::Cursor => match value {
            Value::Null => Ok(()),
            Value::String(token) => crate::cursor::decode_cursor(schema, token).map(|_| ()).map_err(|error| RuntimeError::Input(format!("{label}: {error}"))),
            _ => Err(RuntimeError::Input(format!("{label} must be an opaque cursor string or null"))),
        },
        ArgType::Optional(_) if *value == Value::Null => Ok(()),
        ArgType::Optional(inner) => validate_arg(schema, inner, value, label),
        ArgType::Scalar => match value {
            Value::Row(_) | Value::Map(_) => Err(RuntimeError::Input(format!("{label} must be a scalar"))),
            _ => Ok(()),
        },
        ArgType::Text { max, min, format } => match value {
            Value::String(text) => {
                if let Some(code_point) = disallowed_text_control(text) {
                    return Err(RuntimeError::Input(format!("{label} contains disallowed control character U+{code_point:04X}")));
                }
                if text.chars().count() > *max as usize {
                    return Err(RuntimeError::Input(format!("{label} is longer than {max} characters")));
                }
                validate_text(label, text, *min, *format)
            }
            other => Err(RuntimeError::Input(format!("{label} must be text, not {}", describe(other)))),
        },
        ArgType::List { of, max } | ArgType::ListRange { of, max, .. } => match value {
            Value::Array(items) => {
                if let ArgType::ListRange { min, .. } = kind { validate_list_minimum(label, items.len(), *min)?; }
                if items.len() > *max as usize {
                    return Err(RuntimeError::Input(format!("{label} has more than {max} items")));
                }
                if let Some(of) = of {
                    for item in items {
                        validate_arg(schema, of, item, label)?;
                    }
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            other => Err(RuntimeError::Input(format!("{label} must be a list, not {}", describe(other)))),
        },
        other => {
            let column = crate::schema::arg_as_column(other).ok_or_else(|| RuntimeError::Input(format!("{label} has no column form")))?;
            if fits(&column, Some(value)) { Ok(()) } else { Err(RuntimeError::Input(format!("{label} must be {column}, not {}", describe(value)))) }
        }
    }
}

/// hosts link, speaking one JSON request per line on stdin and one answer
/// per line on stdout, so a JavaScript client can be tested end to end
/// against the real module without a native build, and a host without a
/// linker can still run it.
pub fn device(options: &Options) -> i32 {
    if options.flags.contains_key("engine-info") { println!("{}", serde_json::to_string(&snapback4_core::device_protocol::DeviceEngine::current()).unwrap()); return 0; }
    let Some(path) = options.positionals.first() else {
        eprintln!("usage: {}", crate::cli_flags::synopsis("device"));
        println!("{}", json!({ "denied": { "code": "E_INPUT", "family": "input", "message": format!("usage: {}", crate::cli_flags::synopsis("device")) } }));
        return 2;
    };
    let backend = match options.positionals.get(1) {
        Some(file) => {
            let text = match std::fs::read_to_string(file) {
                Ok(text) => text,
                Err(error) => {
                    let message = format!("device: {file}: {error}");
                    eprintln!("{message}");
                    println!("{}", json!({ "denied": { "code": "E_INPUT", "family": "input", "message": message } }));
                    return 2;
                }
            };
            match snapback4_device::opening::Opening::parse(Some(&text)) {
                Ok(backend) => backend,
                Err(error) => {
                    eprintln!("device: {file}: {error}");
                    println!("{}", json!({ "denied": error.refusal() }));
                    return 2;
                }
            }
        },
        None => snapback4_device::opening::Opening::Kept,
    };
    // Shared device ownership preserves multiple native-process handles while
    // excluding backend hosts and offline commands before any store writes.
    let owner = match crate::store_owner::device(Path::new(path)) {
        Ok(owner) => owner,
        Err(error) => {
            // @ref LLP 3000.019#3.4 — process hosts must receive ownership refusals before readiness.
            let code = if error.starts_with("E_STORE_BUSY ") { "E_STORE_BUSY" } else { "E_STORE" };
            eprintln!("{error}");
            println!("{}", json!({ "denied": { "code": code, "family": "store", "message": error } }));
            return 2;
        }
    };
    let opened = owner.path().and_then(|path| snapback4_device::native::Device::open_with(path, backend));
    let mut device = match opened {
        Ok(device) => device,
        Err(error) => {
            println!("{}", json!({ "denied": error.refusal() }));
            return 1;
        }
    };
    println!("{}", json!({ "ok": { "device": path } }));
    use std::io::{BufRead, Write};
    let stdin = std::io::stdin();
    let mut stdout = std::io::stdout();
    for line in stdin.lock().lines() {
        let Ok(line) = line else { break };
        if line.trim().is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let answer = match snapback4_device::call::try_call_text(&mut device, &line) {
            Ok(answer) => answer,
            Err(error) => json!({ "denied": { "code": "E_INPUT", "family": "input", "message": format!("the request is JSON: {error}") } }),
        };
        if writeln!(stdout, "{answer}").and_then(|()| stdout.flush()).is_err() {
            break;
        }
    }
    0
}

/// "3 tables, 1 view": maintained views are not tables a fixture fills.
// @ref LLP 3000.036#16.5 — wave 6 #20: a view is counted as a view.
pub(crate) fn table_counts(schema: &snapback4_core::schema::Schema) -> String {
    let views = schema.visible_tables().filter(|(name, _)| schema.maintain_for(name).is_some()).count();
    let tables = schema.visible_tables().count() - views;
    let plural = |n: usize, word: &str| format!("{n} {word}{}", if n == 1 { "" } else { "s" });
    if views == 0 { plural(tables, "table") } else { format!("{}, {}", plural(tables, "table"), plural(views, "view")) }
}

//! The catalog: every table (declared or generated for a maintain) with its
//! columns and indexes, plus the named shapes and functions, and where each
//! schema path was declared so a core validation issue can point at a line.

use crate::ast::*;
use crate::diag::{Diagnostic, Site, name_rewrite, unknown};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct TableInfo {
    pub through: Option<snapback4_core::schema::through::Through>,
    pub captures: BTreeMap<String, ScalarType>,
    pub recorded: BTreeMap<String, ScalarType>,
    pub decl: TableDecl,
    pub columns: BTreeMap<String, ScalarType>,
    pub indexes: Vec<IndexDecl>,
    /// Set when the table is a maintain's generated target.
    pub maintained: Option<MaintainDecl>,
}

impl TableInfo {
    pub fn total_unique(&self, index: &IndexDecl) -> bool {
        index.unique && index.is_plain() && index.columns.iter().all(|column| column == "id" || self.columns.get(column).is_some_and(|ty| !ty.optional))
    }

    // @ref LLP 3000.013#2.1 — a scan cursor carries declared components only;
    // uniqueness with a nullable component cannot resolve ties between nulls.
    pub fn total_cursor(&self, index: &IndexDecl) -> bool {
        index.columns.iter().any(|column| column == "id") || index.unique && index.words.is_none()
            && index.columns.iter().all(|column| match index.computed.get(column) {
                Some(expr) => super::time_indexes::key(&self.decl.name, &self.columns, column, expr).is_ok(),
                None => self.columns.get(column).is_some_and(|ty| !ty.optional),
            })
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Catalog {
    pub ordinary_searches: Vec<String>,
    pub source: crate::source::SourceMap,
    pub feed_views: BTreeMap<String, super::feed_view::Plan>,
    pub extremum_domains: BTreeMap<String, ReadExpr>,
    pub read_origins: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    pub canonical_read_origins: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    pub view_reads: BTreeMap<String, crate::ast::MergeExpr>,
    pub view_types: BTreeMap<String, crate::types::Ty>,
    pub planner_notes: Vec<Diagnostic>,
    /// Exact cap declarations that would admit an otherwise fully verified
    /// owner-or-membership page, keyed by the read's source site.
    pub membership_cap_repairs: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    pub synthesized: std::collections::BTreeSet<(String, String)>,
    pub documents: Vec<Document>,
    pub tables: BTreeMap<String, TableInfo>,
    pub maintains: BTreeMap<String, MaintainDecl>,
    pub shapes: BTreeMap<String, ShapeDecl>,
    pub functions: BTreeMap<String, FunctionDecl>,
    pub effects: BTreeMap<String, String>,
}

impl Catalog {
    pub fn build(documents: Vec<Document>, diagnostics: &mut Vec<Diagnostic>) -> Self {
        let mut tables: BTreeMap<String, TableInfo> = BTreeMap::new();
        let mut maintains = BTreeMap::new();
        let mut shapes: BTreeMap<String, ShapeDecl> = BTreeMap::new();
        let mut functions: BTreeMap<String, FunctionDecl> = BTreeMap::new();
        let mut effects = BTreeMap::new();
        let mut effect_sites: BTreeMap<String, Site> = BTreeMap::new();
        for doc in &documents {
            for table in &doc.tables {
                if tables.contains_key(&table.name) {
                    diagnostics.push(unknown(&table.site, format!("duplicate table {}", table.name), "rename one of the two tables"));
                    continue;
                }
                let mut columns = BTreeMap::new();
                let mut ok = true;
                for column in &table.columns {
                    if column.name == "id" {
                        diagnostics.push(unknown(&column.site, format!("table {} gets id implicitly; remove the id column", table.name), "delete this line"));
                        ok = false;
                        continue;
                    }
                    if columns.insert(column.name.clone(), column.type_.clone()).is_some() {
                        diagnostics.push(unknown(&column.site, format!("duplicate column {}.{}", table.name, column.name), "rename one of the two columns"));
                        ok = false;
                    }
                }
                for field in &table.search {
                    if !matches!(columns.get(field), Some(ScalarType { kind: TypeKind::Text { .. } | TypeKind::Enum { .. }, .. })) {
                        diagnostics.push(crate::diag::type_error(&table.site, format!("search {} requires a text or enum column on {}", field, table.name), format!("declare `{field}: text <=2000` or `{field}: enum('one', 'two')` before `search {field}`")).guide("search"));
                    }
                }
                let mut indexes = vec![IndexDecl { name: "byId".into(), columns: vec!["id".into()], unique: true, refusal: None, words: None, computed: BTreeMap::new(), site: table.site.clone() }];
                for index in &table.indexes {
                    if indexes.iter().any(|existing| existing.name == index.name) {
                        diagnostics.push(unknown(&index.site, format!("duplicate index {}.{}", table.name, index.name), "name one ordering explicitly"));
                        ok = false;
                        continue;
                    }
                    for column in &index.columns {
                        if index.computed.contains_key(column) { continue; }
                        if column != "id" && !columns.contains_key(column) {
                            diagnostics.push(crate::diag::type_error(&index.site, format!("index {}.{} names unknown column {column}", table.name, index.name), name_rewrite(column, columns.keys().map(String::as_str).chain(["id"]), None)));
                            ok = false;
                        }
                    }
                    for field in index.words.iter().flat_map(|(_, fields)| fields) {
                        match columns.get(field) {
                            Some(ScalarType { kind: TypeKind::Text { .. } | TypeKind::Enum { .. }, .. }) => {}
                            // The table stays in the catalog: one line is
                            // wrong, and its readers should hear about that
                            // line, not about a table that vanished.
                            Some(other) => diagnostics.push(crate::diag::type_error(&index.site, format!("index {}.{} tokenizes {field}, which is {}, not text or enum", table.name, index.name, crate::print::scalar_type(other)), format!("words(<a text or enum column of {}>)", table.name))),
                            None => diagnostics.push(crate::diag::type_error(&index.site, format!("index {}.{} tokenizes unknown column {field}", table.name, index.name), name_rewrite(field, columns.keys().map(String::as_str), None))),
                        }
                    }
                    for (name, expr) in &index.computed {
                        if let Err(error) = super::time_indexes::key(&table.name, &columns, name, expr) { diagnostics.push(error); }
                    }
                    indexes.push(index.clone());
                }
                let mut seen_effects = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
                for rule in &table.rules {
                    if !seen_effects.insert(rule.effect) {
                        if rule.effect == Effect::Read && table.rules.iter().any(|r| matches!(&r.value,Expr::Call{name,..} if matches!(name.as_str(), "$readThrough" | "$readThroughLive"))) {
                            diagnostics.push(Diagnostic::new(&rule.site,"E_READ_THROUGH",format!("{} declares another read rule beside read through",table.name),"keep read through as the whole read rule; put service grants on the parent").guide("rules"));
                        } else {
                            let first = table.rules.iter().find(|first| first.effect == rule.effect).unwrap();
                            diagnostics.push(Diagnostic::new(&rule.site, "E_QUARRY_DUPLICATE_RULE", format!("duplicate {} rule on {}; first declared at {}", rule.effect.word(), table.name, first.site), "keep one rule per effect; combine intended alternatives with or in that one rule").guide("rules"));
                        }
                        // Keep the usable declaration to avoid cascading unknown-table errors.

                    }
                }
                if ok {
                    let mut decl = table.clone();
                    let mut effects = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
                    decl.rules.retain(|rule| effects.insert(rule.effect));
                    // @ref LLP 3000.036.002#9 — rejected search metadata must not erase the usable table symbol.
                    // An invalid search field is a fault of that search line,
                    // not evidence that every later reference names an
                    // unknown table. Keep the usable table symbol and omit
                    // only search fields that could not be indexed.
                    decl.search.retain(|field| matches!(columns.get(field), Some(ScalarType { kind: TypeKind::Text { .. } | TypeKind::Enum { .. }, .. })));
                    // @ref LLP 3000.015#2 — catalog consumers see the same
                    // implicit immutability as runtime schema consumers.
                    for column in &table.columns {
                        if let Some(parent) = &column.sequence {
                            decl.immutable.push((vec![column.name.clone(), parent.clone()], column.site.clone()));
                        }
                    }
                    tables.insert(table.name.clone(), TableInfo { through: None, captures: BTreeMap::new(), recorded: BTreeMap::new(), decl, columns, indexes, maintained: None });
                }
            }
            for maintain in &doc.maintains {
                let mut maintain = maintain.clone();
                super::maintains::normalize_keys(&mut maintain);
                if maintain.row_key.is_none()
                    && maintain.by.is_empty()
                    && matches!(maintain.name.as_str(), "viewer" | "now" | "commit" | "new")
                {
                    diagnostics.push(Diagnostic::new(&maintain.site, "E_QUARRY_RESERVED",
                        format!("global maintained scalar `{}` would shadow Quarry's contextual `{}` builtin", maintain.name, maintain.name),
                        format!("rename the view, for example `view total{}: ...`", maintain.name[..1].to_uppercase() + &maintain.name[1..])).guide("maintains"));
                    continue;
                }
                if tables.contains_key(&maintain.name) || maintains.contains_key(&maintain.name) {
                    diagnostics.push(unknown(&maintain.site, format!("maintain {} collides with a table of the same name", maintain.name), "rename the aggregate view"));
                    continue;
                }
                maintains.insert(maintain.name.clone(), maintain);
            }
            for shape in &doc.shapes {
                if let Some(first) = shapes.get(&shape.name) {
                    diagnostics.push(unknown(&shape.site, format!("duplicate shape {}; first declared at {}", shape.name, first.site), "rename one shape"));
                    continue;
                }
                shapes.insert(shape.name.clone(), shape.clone());
            }
            for function in &doc.functions {
                if let Some(first) = functions.get(&function.name) {
                    diagnostics.push(unknown(&function.site, format!("duplicate fn {}; first declared at {}", function.name, first.site), "rename one function"));
                    continue;
                }
                // @ref LLP 3000.040#12-surface — a bound belongs to a slot a value enters (a column or an operation's argument); a helper is inlined and has none.
                for param in &function.args {

                            format!("declare `{}: int` and bound the operation's argument or the stored column as {range}", param.name)).guide("types"));
                    }

//! @ref LLP 3000.000.000.000#3-generated-compatibility — opt-in types span a saved baseline and current source.
use super::*;

pub(super) fn args(current: &[(String, Ty)], old: Option<&[(String, Ty)]>, since: Option<u64>) -> String {
    if current.is_empty() { return "Record<string, never>".into(); }
    format!("{{ {} }}", current.iter().map(|(name, ty)| {
        let added = old.is_some_and(|old| !old.iter().any(|(n, _)| n == name));
        let optional = ty.is_optional();
        format!("{}{}{}: {}", if added { format!("/** Since release {}. */ ", since.unwrap()) } else { String::new() }, property(name), if optional { "?" } else { "" }, ty_ts(ty))
    }).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("; "))
}

pub(super) fn result(current: &Ty, old: Option<&Ty>, since: Option<u64>) -> String {
    let Some(old) = old else { return ty_ts(current) };
    if current == old { return ty_ts(current); }
    match (current, old) {
        (Ty::Object(fields) | Ty::RowShape(fields) | Ty::RowObject(fields), Ty::Object(before) | Ty::RowShape(before) | Ty::RowObject(before)) => {
            let mut fields = fields.iter().map(|(name, ty)| {
                let optional = !before.contains_key(name);
                format!("{}{}{}: {}", if optional { format!("/** Since release {}; optional: releases before {} lack this column. */ ", since.unwrap(), since.unwrap()) } else { String::new() }, property(name), if optional { "?" } else { "" }, result(ty, before.get(name), since))
            }).collect::<Vec<_>>();
            if matches!(current, Ty::RowShape(_) | Ty::RowObject(_)) { fields.push("pending?: boolean".into()); fields.push("retained?: boolean".into()); }
            format!("{{ {} }}", fields.join("; "))
        }
        (Ty::Optional(a), Ty::Optional(b)) => format!("{} | null", result(a, Some(b), since)),
        (Ty::List(a, _) | Ty::Collection(a, _), Ty::List(b, _) | Ty::Collection(b, _)) => format!("Array<{}>", result(a, Some(b), since)),
        // Nominal rows expand through Rows; value unions retain old enum/value domains.
        (Ty::Row(a), Ty::Row(b)) | (Ty::Page(a, _), Ty::Page(b, _)) if a == b => ty_ts(current),
        (Ty::Enum(a), Ty::Enum(b)) => {
            let mut variants = a.clone();
            for variant in b { if !variants.contains(variant) { variants.push(variant.clone()); } }
            ty_ts(&Ty::Enum(variants))
        }
        _ => {
            fn atoms(ty: &Ty, baseline: bool, out: &mut Vec<String>) {
                let mut add = |text| { if !out.contains(&text) { out.push(text); } };
                match ty {
                    Ty::Optional(inner) => { atoms(inner, baseline, out); if !out.iter().any(|atom| atom == "null") { out.push("null".into()); } }
                    Ty::Enum(variants) => for variant in variants { add(string_literal(variant)); },
                    _ => add(if baseline { baseline_type(ty) } else { ty_ts(ty) }),
                }
            }
            let mut union = Vec::new(); atoms(current, false, &mut union); atoms(old, true, &mut union);
            // Plain strings already include every enum literal, even through an optional.
            if union.iter().any(|atom| atom == "string") { union.retain(|atom| !atom.starts_with('"')); }
            union.join(" | ")
        },
    }
}

/// Keep baseline nominal types in their own namespace: a table may no longer
/// exist, or may now have a different public row shape.
fn baseline_type(ty: &Ty) -> String {
    match ty {
        Ty::Row(table) => format!("BaselineRows[{}]", string_literal(table)),
        Ty::WriteRow(table) => format!("BaselineWriteRows[{}]", string_literal(table)),
        Ty::Page(table, _) => format!("BaselineRows[{}][]", string_literal(table)),
        Ty::Optional(inner) => format!("{} | null", baseline_type(inner)),
        Ty::List(inner, _) | Ty::Collection(inner, _) => format!("Array<{}>", baseline_type(inner)),
        Ty::Object(fields) | Ty::RowShape(fields) | Ty::RowObject(fields) => {
            let mut parts = fields.iter().map(|(name, ty)| format!("{}: {}", property(name), baseline_type(ty))).collect::<Vec<_>>();
            if matches!(ty, Ty::RowShape(_) | Ty::RowObject(_)) { parts.push("pending?: boolean".into()); parts.push("retained?: boolean".into()); }
            if parts.is_empty() { "Record<string, never>".into() } else { format!("{{ {} }}", parts.join("; ")) }
        }
        _ => ty_ts(ty),
    }
}

pub(super) fn baseline_rows(bound: &Bound, out: &mut String) {
    out.push_str("type BaselineRows = {\n");
    for (name, table) in bound.schema.visible_tables() {
        out.push_str(&format!("  {}: {{\n", property(name)));
        for (column, kind) in table.columns.iter().filter(|(name, _)| !table.engine_field(name) && !snapback4_core::schema::timeline::is_slot(name)) {
            out.push_str(&format!("    {}{}: {};\n", property(column), if table.private_field(column) { "?" } else { "" }, column_ts(kind, &bound.schema)));
        }
        out.push_str("    pending?: boolean; retained?: boolean;\n  };\n");
    }
    for (name, ty) in &bound.view_types { out.push_str(&format!("  {}: {};\n", property(name), baseline_type(ty))); }
    out.push_str("};\ntype BaselineWriteRows = {\n");
    for (name, table) in bound.schema.visible_tables() {
        let fields = table.maintained.keys().map(|name| string_literal(name)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" | ");
        out.push_str(&format!("  {}: Omit<BaselineRows[{}], {}>;\n", property(name), string_literal(name), if fields.is_empty() { "never" } else { &fields }));
    }
    out.push_str("};\n\n");
}

mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn value_unions_deduplicate_through_optional_and_string_domains() {
        assert_eq!(result(&Ty::Text(80), Some(&Ty::Optional(Box::new(Ty::Text(40)))), Some(2)), "string | null");
        assert_eq!(result(&Ty::Enum(vec!["open".into(), "held".into()]), Some(&Ty::Optional(Box::new(Ty::Enum(vec!["open".into(), "closed".into()])))), Some(2)), "\"open\" | \"held\" | \"closed\" | null");
        assert_eq!(result(&Ty::Enum(vec!["open".into()]), Some(&Ty::Text(40)), Some(2)), "string");
    }
}
// @ref LLP 3000.000.000.000#2-served-capabilities — authenticated metadata, never authority to execute.
import type { Refusal } from "./contract.ts";

/** The public Quarry wire type shared by column and argument descriptions. */
export type ServedType = "Id" | "Principal" | "Int" | "Bool" | "Time" | "Cursor" | "Scalar"
  | { readonly Ref: { readonly table: string } }
  | { readonly Text: { readonly max: number; readonly min?: number; readonly format?: string | null } }
  | { readonly Bytes: { readonly max: number } } | { readonly Image: { readonly max: number; readonly once?: boolean } }
  | { readonly Video: { readonly max: number } } | { readonly File: { readonly max: number; readonly types?: readonly string[] } }
  | { readonly Json: { readonly max_bytes: number } } | { readonly IntRange: { readonly min?: number; readonly max?: number } }
  | { readonly Enum: { readonly variants: readonly string[] } } | { readonly Decimal: { readonly scale: number } }
  | { readonly Money: { readonly currency: string; readonly scale: number } } | { readonly Optional: ServedType }
  | { readonly List: { readonly of?: ServedType | null; readonly max: number } }
  | { readonly ListRange: { readonly of?: ServedType | null; readonly min: number; readonly max: number } };
export interface ServedOperation { readonly kind: "query" | "mutation" | "action"; readonly args: Readonly<Record<string, ServedType>> }
export interface ServedRelease {
  readonly generation: number;
  readonly operations: Readonly<Record<string, ServedOperation>>;
  readonly tables: Readonly<Record<string, { readonly fields: Readonly<Record<string, ServedType>> }>>;
}
export type ReleaseSnapshot = ServedRelease | { readonly loading: true } | { readonly denied: Refusal };
export interface ReleaseSource {
  getSnapshot(): ReleaseSnapshot;
  subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void;
}
export const releaseLoading: ReleaseSnapshot = Object.freeze({ loading: true });
const object = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> => !!value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);
const canonical = (value: unknown): string => JSON.stringify(value, (_, item) => object(item)
  ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(item).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))) : item);

/** A conservative signature check. A release switch may race it: still handle E_OP/E_INPUT. */
export function operationAvailable(release: ReleaseSnapshot, name: string, kind: string, args: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
  if (!("generation" in release)) return false;
  const op = release.operations[name];
  return !!op && op.kind === kind
    && Object.entries(args).every(([name, type]) => canonical(op.args[name]) === canonical(type))
    && Object.entries(op.args).every(([name, type]) => Object.hasOwn(args, name) || (object(type) && Object.hasOwn(type, "Optional")));
}

function freeze<T>(value: T): T {
  if (value && typeof value === "object") { for (const child of Object.values(value)) freeze(child); Object.freeze(value); }
  return value;
}

function decode(value: unknown): ServedRelease | undefined {
  if (!object(value) || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.generation) || !Array.isArray(value.ops) || !Array.isArray(value.tables)) return;
  const operations: Record<string, ServedOperation> = Object.create(null);
  const tables: Record<string, { fields: Record<string, ServedType> }> = Object.create(null);
  for (const op of value.ops) {
    if (!object(op) || typeof op.name !== "string" || !["query", "mutation", "action"].includes(op.kind as string) || !object(op.args)) return;
    operations[op.name] = freeze({ kind: op.kind as ServedOperation["kind"], args: op.args as Record<string, ServedType> });
  }
  for (const table of value.tables) {
    if (!object(table) || typeof table.name !== "string" || !object(table.fields)) return;
    tables[table.name] = freeze({ fields: table.fields as Record<string, ServedType> });
  }
  return Object.freeze({ generation: value.generation as number, operations: Object.freeze(operations), tables: Object.freeze(tables) });
}

/** Subscriptions keep a small catalog poll alive even when all query gates are closed.
 * Ordinary traffic withdraws the previous snapshot as soon as it observes a newer generation. */
export function servedRelease(options: { url: string; fetch: typeof fetch; headers(): Record<string, string>; current(): boolean }) {
  let snapshot: ReleaseSnapshot = releaseLoading;
  let credential = canonical(options.headers()), minimum = -1, closed = false, revision = 0;
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined, pending: Promise<void> | undefined;
  let aborter: AbortController | undefined;
  const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  const identity = () => canonical(options.headers());
  const publish = (next: ReleaseSnapshot) => { if (snapshot === next) return; snapshot = next; for (const listener of listeners) listener(); };
  const active = () => !closed && options.current();
  const getSnapshot = (): ReleaseSnapshot => {
    if (!active() || credential !== identity()) return releaseLoading;
    return snapshot;
  };
  const schedule = (delay: number) => {
    if (timer !== undefined || !listeners.size || closed) return;
    timer = setTimeout(() => { timer = undefined; void refresh(); }, delay);
  };
  async function refresh() {
    if (pending || !listeners.size || closed) return;
    const key = identity(), epoch = revision;
    if (credential !== key) { credential = key; minimum = -1; publish(releaseLoading); }
    if (!active()) { publish(releaseLoading); schedule(1000); return; }
    aborter = new AbortController();
    // A hung metadata request cannot hold the subscription forever.
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => aborter?.abort(), 10000);
    const work = (async () => {
      try {
        const response = await options.fetch(`${options.url}/`, { headers: { ...options.headers() }, signal: aborter!.signal });
        const value: unknown = await response.json();
        if (!active() || epoch !== revision || key !== identity()) return;
        if (object(value) && object(value.denied) && typeof value.denied.code === "string") {
          publish({ denied: value.denied as unknown as Refusal }); return;
        }
        const next = response.ok ? decode(value) : undefined;
        if (!next || next.generation < minimum) { publish(releaseLoading); return; }
        minimum = next.generation;
        if (!("generation" in snapshot) || canonical(next) !== canonical(snapshot)) publish(next);
      } catch { if (active() && epoch === revision && key === identity()) publish(releaseLoading); }
      finally { clearTimeout(timeout); }
    })();
    pending = work;
    await work;
    pending = undefined;
    schedule(1000);
  }
  return {
    getSnapshot,
    subscribe(listener: () => void) {
      if (closed) return () => {};
      listeners.add(listener); schedule(0);
      return () => {
        listeners.delete(listener);
        if (!listeners.size) {
          if (timer !== undefined) clearTimeout(timer); timer = undefined;
          revision++; aborter?.abort(); snapshot = releaseLoading;
        }
      };
    },
    invalidate() {
      revision++; aborter?.abort(); publish(releaseLoading);
      if (timer !== undefined) clearTimeout(timer); timer = undefined; schedule(0);
    },
    hint(response: Response) {
      const key = identity();
      if (credential !== key) { credential = key; minimum = -1; revision++; aborter?.abort(); publish(releaseLoading); }
      const value = response.headers.get("x-snapback-generation");
      const next = value === null ? NaN : Number(value);
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(next) || next <= minimum || !active()) return;
      minimum = next; publish(releaseLoading);
      if (!pending) { if (timer !== undefined) clearTimeout(timer); timer = undefined; schedule(0); }
    },
    close() {
      closed = true; revision++; aborter?.abort();
      if (timer !== undefined) clearTimeout(timer); timer = undefined;
      publish(releaseLoading); listeners.clear();
    },
  };
}
